This is a mod that replaces Mario with Lillie from Pokémon Sun and Moon, and other added extras. This mod includes:


Replaces Mario with Lillie, including replacements for all of Mario's power-ups, Cosmic Mario, and more!

Replaces Peach with Lusamine and Baby Luma with Nebby

Replaces Bowser with Necrozma and Bowser Jr. with Nihilego

Replaces NPC Luigi with Gladion, and playable Luigi with Liko (from Pokémon Horizons) and all of Luigi's power-ups and more

Level edits in Toy Time Galaxy

Custom file select icons and planets

Lots of custom icons, textures, and pictures

Custom title screen

Optional custom cutscenes

Voice clips

Edits to in-game dialogue and text

Effect recolors

Multiple music track edits

A custom Wii banner

Custom end credits screen with custom music

Custom health meter icons

Working Wii Message Board pictures that display on the Wii Message Board


Previous versions (below version 4.4.0) of this mod are here for archival purposes. Luigi does not work correctly in these versions, and has Lillie's hands due to Mario and Luigi sharing the same hand models. These versions are buggy and contain lots of issues. Version 4.4.0 is the most stable, with all available content. It is recommended to use this version.

There will likely be significant lag when playing on an actual Wii in Toy Time Galaxy. It is recommended to play the mod on Dolphin Emulator, because of this.

Special thanks to Humming Owl and the Luma's Workshop Discord community for helping me get this mod working correctly.

This mod is built for the USA version of Super Mario Galaxy. This mod also has compatibility with the Japanese version, and the Korean version. Support for the PAL version has not been added yet. The PAL version may work, but any text edits won't be visible, and there may be a crash when speaking to the Purple Luma in Toy Time Galaxy since the custom text couldn't be loaded. French and Spanish text hasn't been supported yet either, but is planned.

profile._sName: Southern Hemisphere for Animal Crossing: City Folk
profile._sText:
Experience Animal Crossing: City Folk with a true Southern Hemisphere seasonal cycle.

Southern Hemisphere shifts the game's natural seasons by six months while keeping the normal civil calendar completely intact.

This means that players in Australia, New Zealand, South America and other Southern Hemisphere regions can finally experience City Folk with seasons matching their real-world calendar.

January is summer. July is winter.

Unlike a simple visual season swap, this mod also adjusts the game's natural seasonal systems, including vegetation, fish and insects.

Features

  • Southern Hemisphere seasonal cycle.
  • Seasonal vegetation and environmental visuals shifted by six months.
  • Fish availability shifted by six months.
  • Insect availability shifted by six months.
  • Natural Southern Hemisphere winter snow.
  • Natural snowfall during the Southern winter.
  • Snowballs and Snowman appear during the Southern winter.
  • The normal civil calendar remains untouched.
Southern winter:
June 11 at 6:00 AM → August 25 at 5:59 AM.

The mod does not modify:

  • The visible date.
  • The year or RTC.
  • Birthdays.
  • Holidays and special events.
  • Mail dates/timestamps.
  • The Town Calendar.
For example, Christmas still occurs in December even though December is now summer, just as it does in the real Southern Hemisphere.

Compatibility

  • Animal Crossing: City Folk
  • USA / NTSC-U
  • Game ID: RUUE01
  • Revision: Rev0
  • Dolphin Emulator with Riivolution patch support
  • Tested with Revolution Forest Plus / City Folk Deluxe v1.1.2
Other game regions or revisions are currently unsupported.

This mod does not modify your save format.

Manual installation

Copy both XML files from the included riivolution folder to:

%APPDATA%\Dolphin Emulator\Load\Riivolution\riivolution\

Then enable these options: 

Deluxe Plus [MT02]

Southern Hemisphere Vegetation → Enabled (South)

MT03 Fauna Test [USA Rev0]

MT03A Southern Fish → Enabled

MT03B Southern Insects → Enabled

Bored of your plain ol' rocks and want some pizzazz?

This mod works on Dolphin emulator.
How to install the mod:
1. Download and extract the zip folder.
2. Go to Dolphin Emulator > Load > Textures

Game ID: 
  • RUUE01 = America
  • RUUP01 = Europe

profile._sText:
A Quality of Life/ Rebalance mod for Radiant Dawn.

Radiant Dawn is my favorite Fire Emblem game. Unfortunately, it has multiple issues, chief among them being that quite a large percentage of characters are suboptimal, or flat out near unusable, the worst offender being units like Fiona or Lyre.

Well no more. With the Power of Thane's Paragon Editor, in Radiant Dawn+, I think I managed to make everyone useable while still keeping it faithful enough to the original game, something a lot of upcoming Radiant Dawn mods change completely gameplay wise to the point of it being unrecognizable as Radiant Dawn.

Key changes include:
General growth and base buffs for both characters and classes, especially mages
Buffed Weapon triangle, 10->15%
stronger magic across the board
Thunder magic is now 1-3 range
New weapons, including PRFs and magic weapons.
Laguz changes, untransformed forms no longer as weak and can initiate combat
No need for a clear file or transfers for additional content
Shop and forge changes (can forge el-tomes and wind edges)
More interesting and difficult bosses

https://forums.serenesforest.net/index.php?/topic/98480-fe10-radient-dawn-a-fe10-qolrebalance-mod/

profile._sText:
Path of Heroes is a mod for FE10; Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn. Inspired by the likes of the Micaiah’s Pyre tome in Fire Emblem: Awakening and Emblem Soren’s Cataclysm in Fire Emblem: Engage, the Path of Heroes mod adds one or more unique personal weapons (PRF) to every playable unit in the game. Most, but not all, of these are based on the large myriad of PRF weapons present in the mobile title Fire Emblem: Heroes. 

The Path of Heroes mod was made exclusively with the Paragon tool from thane98. All content within the mod, and the box art found above, were solely created by me (PaldeanRTT). Special shoutouts to Kalen (Radiant Dawn+) and ViciousSal (Project Daybreak) for their helpful modding advice, to Windward for creating the .xdelta patch for easier installation,  and to my friends missshusii and prettysour for their graphical help and suggestions when creating the box art. 

Path of Heroes is not a difficulty mod, nor does it actively change any existing stats, growth rates, classes or units - with a few small exceptions. Unless noted otherwise in the later documentation, assume the only changes are the PRF weapons. Path of Heroes is mostly designed to maintain the vanilla FE10 experience, just with added weapons.

Kirby's Heroes Most Dark, remember that? me neither! ha, anywayz, for Kirby Fighters Wii, HMD's Zero is going to be in a stage, so i figured i should get a good Zero model for it, based on the "New Zero Model (Unfinished)" from hmd's files


if you want latest (stable)hmd to use this with, download mindnebulapreview, then put the files from finalbetapatch(inside hmd archives) onto that and replace duplicate files, then ya can use this model(if you want to on console than instead of the illegal sys folder you can use the stuff from HMD-codes.txt, but the wall cling code will crash, so remove it)

it's different from the earlier model in that the eye textures are changed, and the red(angry) eye has the cuts from dl3, credit 2 dudeluke, "new zero model" sounds much more exciting than that, but it's his name for it, i tell you hwat. this is based on the version that had texture cuts, the blend file has 3d modelled cuts, i think the textures were the first plan but dudeluke didn't know how to get them to work so he switched to 3d(escecially as the blend file was the last edited one), i made this half 4 fun and half 4 kirby fighters wii(03 will be there in one form and/or another)

i wrote most of this before i decided i wanted to include it, but i also included a tweak to the kunai attack to remove the weird effect, and a fixed version of the shooter cutter attack dudeluke made, he said he "already made it", but it's only within the "extracted mint" from the latestestest thing, and it doesn't damage bosses or cut ropes, and there was a bug where the effect lingered if you tried to do the attack a second time or got hit, so i fixed those things, nothing else of the crazy new stuff is there, you'd need to tweak a couple of things(add some lines to the start of the edited mint stuff outside of ninja because that newer mint changes those scripts, i did that but didn't release because most things crash), is triggered by hitting an enemy or projectile with the down + 1 air attack, not sure why he didn't just have it be the down + 1 air attack itself, maybe he was planning on it? is visually cool though

Here is my take on what a more in-depth moveset for Ultra Sword would be!


This mod overhauls the entire Ultra Sword ability to make it something new that I hope will be fun to play!

Reworked Ultra Sword moveset

  • 1 : Sword Slam
  • B : Sword Throw
  • 1 or B after Sword Throw : Sword Recall
  • 1 in midair : Sword Spin
  • 1 in midair + any direction : Sword Dash
  • Down + 1 in midair while running : Sword Meteor
  • Hit the ground during Sword Meteor : Sword Plant
  • 1 or 2 during Sword Plant : Sword Jump

This mod also changes the first ability room in the Lor, the Arena and True Arena ability select rooms to include a new copy essence that will give you the Ultra Sword ability.

Enjoy!

profile._sName: The Elm. Warriors in Return to Dream Land DEMO
profile._sText:
About 2 years ago, I'd release the video "WE Return to Dream Land;" it featured a mod made by DudeLuke where my pals: Spar, RunOut, Spax, and I, also known as The Elm. Warriors, were modded into the game with some of our canonical abilities. 2 years later, a lot of super ambitious work has been done on the project to really bring it to life!

This is a demo of a full game mod that changes abilities, graphics, animations, levels, and more! The demo features all of World 1, Ex-Lucky Fields.

Changes:

Abilities

The Sword, Spear, Hammer, and Ice abilities have been changed into Ranger, Spar, RunOut and Spax respectively.
- Ranger, the Lightning Warrior, has new electrified moves, and a stun zap that can stun enemies in place for whole seconds at a time!
- Spar, the Fire Spowman, wields a flaming Spow (a Spear-Bow combo) that can scorch enemies and even shoot arrows!
- RunOut, the Energy Swordsman, has many unique abilities such as lasers and an item absorb move.
- Spax, the Goofy Ice Boi, is packed with ice bombs and ice magic, coming equip with a Frost Spin attack, used by simply running and jumping!

Levels

Blocks and Enemies have been modified to accommodate the Elm. Warriors; some things now require an Elm. Warrior to access.

Energy Spheres

Most all Energy Spheres are modified to be more easily / required to be collected by an Elm. Warrior. NOTE: Only one Energy Sphere is actually collectable in the demo!

Other Dimensions

World themes effect Other Dimensions completely! The segments are now based on preexisting Ranger the Warrior videos.

Elm. Studios

In place of the Ability Rooms sits a Warp Star that takes you to Elm. Studios. Not every room is available in the demo, but most are, such as the Lobby, Break Room, Studio Floor, Elm. Suites, and even Ranger Selects!

... and More!

Various changes have been made to the game, from animations, to pause screen descriptions, to even in-level dialogue! (Courtesy of Fyik). Explore and see what you can find!

I will be continuing to work on the full release! It's well into development at this point and it shouldn't be too long before it's out! Thank you too all who have supported me and this project, and I hope you all enjoy!

"... and with that being said, I'll see y'all next time!"

profile._sText:
It's about time ! After about a year of development (I lacked most of the time due to college), the most underrated final Kirby weapon, Kirby's Dream Land 2's Rainbow Sword, has been ported to Return to Dream Land ! Unfortunately, I still haven't figured out, nor has it been discovered how to reflect projectile-based attacks. The following changes are:

- A Rainbow Drop replaces the usual Sword ability icon.

- Flight Slash over Sword Chop: like the name suggests, Kirby very literally flies (not float) in that state, as in he maintains the gained height and can even move around (up, down, left right). To make the explanation simple, imagine yourself in the Dream Land 2 Dark Matter battle. However, due to game limitations, he can't turn left or right, only forward, so keep that noted. Also, he attacks that way underwater, but doesn't have the movement there.

- Drill Stab burns and can cover about twice its usual distance.

- Multisword Attack burns.

- Spin Slash freezes.

- Upward Flight over Raising : this move is based on the Dedede to Dark Matter cutscene transition. Kirby immediately goes flying in the air, making him invincible. However, because I changed the hitbox, you can't make a combo out of Drill Stab and it will be hard to attack enemies with it. It can be used for evasive maneuvers or for speedrun strategies.

- Sword Dive and Meteor can pound stakes. And Sword Dive's final hitbox electrocutes.

- Rainbow Bridge over Sword Spin: this move is by far the most broken out of the other ones I've mentionned. It is based on Dream Land 2's True Ending sequence where Kirby reforges the Rainbow Bridge Dark Matter broke (hence the name of the move). Keep it mind that it gives him a big speed boost that (even for me) is hard to control. Like Upward Flight, it makes Kirby invincible and can also be used for speedrun strategies.

- Sword Beam has been disabled (it doesn't affect Meta Knight though).

- All of Rainbow Sword's attacks have Super Ability properties (minus the Pop Flowers, Arrow Signs and Billboards disappearing), therefore they can break any Block.

So far, this has been my most ambitious project, with the movement done thanks to Mint and Gecko Codes I've made (one of them made by DudeLuke).
This to be said, I hope you enjoy this mod !

profile._sText:
Oh what do you know, I guess I am gonna be using this account again. I have a hard time staying away from modding.

To get some rust off, here's the Meta-Knights! These four all share a whole moveset not unlike Kirby Star Allies' Rick, Kine, and Coo. They automatically switch between each other when necessary to do certain moves. Unlike the animal friends though, using a move lets you stay as that knight until you do another move to switch back out. (So it's also kinda like the Mage Sisters? Though only purely visual)

Alongside this, this is my first mod to feature a new discovery in mint, the ability to set a player's velocity! It may seem small, but this alone unlocks a plethora of new possibilities that I may just be exploring in the future. Otherwise, this is really just another basic moveset edit for Bandana Dee. I just liked those four and their unique weapons, so I wanted to give them a chance as playable heroes!

Moveset

1: Axe Chop
Cutter's first hit of Cleaving Cutter.

1 Twice: Dual Chop
Cutter's second hit of Cleaving Cutter.

1 Thrice or Forward + 1: Axe Boomerang
A cutter-like axe projectile that returns very quickly when thrown!

2 in Midair: Knightly Nitrous
Trident Knight uses his Jetpack(?) that allows him to fly, it moves and functions much like Spear Copter, only without any timer!

1 in midair: Javelin Twirl
Hover in midair while spinning as Javelin Knight.

1 During Javelin Spin: Javelin Ignite
A follow-up attack that deals fire damage.

Down + 1: Mace Flail
Mace Knight spins a mace around, release 1 to send it flying! While slower, its range and damage more than make up for it.

Down + 1 in Midair: Trident Rush
A new move that lets Trident Knight charge forward in midair! Good for dodging through bosses with its invincibility frames.

Dash + 1: Mace Masher
An overhead mace attack that can pound stakes.

Dash + 1 in Midair: Mace Crasher
Mace Knight swings his mace and the momentum sends him forward!

Up + 1 in Midair: Trident Toss
Mostly the same as normal Spear Throw.

1 in Water: Javelin Whirlpool
Javelin Knight takes over when water's involved, his Javelin Twirl becoming the only usable move.

Important information before you play the mod:
Ignore the dolphin error message when doing the thrust attack.
The fire ball/burning attack of the fire ability is now broken due to the way I handled spawning the fire behind the thrust attck. It may be fix in an update, but I don't promise it will be.
The bug that killed Kirby in the world map when doing the thurst attack has been fixed.

This mod modifies the base game sword ability by modifying most moves and adding a completely new one.
The spesific changes are:
-A new model for the sword.
-When pressing down and 1 in the floor Kirby will create a flame that does considerable damage (requires the gecko code to work properly).
-When landing after the meteor attack Kirby will create a similar flame.
-The thrust attack will now create the same fire "weapons" (in game term for entities such as projectiles that have models and hitboxes but no hp) from the fire burning attack. (requires the gecko code).
-The sword beam will now has a fire effect hitbox instead of a sword one (requires the gecko code).
-The underwater sword spin has been replaced with a new attack.
-The air sword spin now has a fire effect that does less damage but covers a bigger area. The base hit box is still there, so you will be able to do the same amount of damage as in vanilla if you attack an enemy from a closer distant.
-The under thrust now creates a fire when landing.
-The sword spin now has a fire effect.

A mod that removes all water from every stage that has it. The water is still visible, but you can't swim in it. 

Some minor changes have been made to certain stages, specifically (re)moving blocks, so that every stage is possible without a Copy Ability.

Since this mod was made before moving terrain could be edited, it's all be stationary without any collision. But don't worry, every stage is still possible.

Here's a list of all the changed stages:
  • Raisin Ruins - Hub
  • Raisin Ruins - Stage 2
  • Onion Ocean - Stage 1 (The rafts and moving terrain in the Another Dimension section don't work)
  • Onion Ocean - Stage 2 (The moving terrain to get to the bonus area doesn't work. Minor changes so the stage is possible without ability)
  • Onion Ocean - Stage 3 (Minor changes so the stage is possible without ability)
  • Onion Ocean - Stage 4 (The moving terrain in the first room doesn't work. Minor changes so the stage is possible without ability)
  • Onion Ocean - Stage 5
  • White Wafers - Stage 3 (The moving terrain right at the start and before the first Energy Sphere don't work)
  • Egg Engines - Stage 2
  • Egg Engines - Stage 3 (Another Dimension section)
  • Egg Engines - Stage 4 (The moving spikes in the third room don't work
  •  Dangerous Dinner - Stage 2 (The moving terrain in the Another Dimension section doesn't have collision)
  • Dangerous Dinner - Stage 3 (Another Dimension section)

I've never modded a game like this before so I hope I did it well!

Not a fan of the Tornado ability? Do you wish it was more controllable? Well me too, so I made this mod!

This mod basically changes the Tornado with custom code to have new moves made by yours truly.

The moveset :
- 1 : Tornado Attack : Kirby spins around and creates a small tornado, very basic.
- Dash + 1 : Tornado Throw : Kirby throws a Tornado in the air, requires a good amount of aiming and positioning.
- Down + 1 : Sky Tornado : Kirby creates a tornado and pulls it downward. This attack also goes in the ground and can hit switches that are not too far below Kirby.
- Up + 1 : Quadruple Tornado : Kirby creates 4 small tornadoes around him and sends them in the air with great speed.
- Down + 1 in the air : Double Tornado Throw : Kirby sends two Tornadoes towards the ground.

This mod uses Gecko Codes! In the main download there is a main.dol file that has the Gecko Codes preloaded so if you're only using this mod you just have to replace your main.dol file with the one in the download.

profile._sText:
This mod mostly started as just a tool for my own personal use in modding, but after a few extra additions and a fancy new model put together using Team Kirby Clash Deluxe's Beast Hammer as a base, the mod's now public for anyone's use!

The Hamm_ERR is a handy tool for mint coders and debuggers alike, with nearly every move used to test certain features in the game. In Mint, the code used for KRtDL, visual effects, sounds, attack types, etc, usually go off a comprehensive ID list. The Hamm_ERR can cycle through these lists and displays the ID value using Metal General's damage effect. Just keep a Decimal to Hexadecimal converter on-hand and you can find the exact value usable by mint!

Moveset

1: Kill Hammer - create one massive, screen-clearing hitbox that functions like a super ability, killing any enemy or boss instantly. You can even use the move while under the water.
Air + 1: Effect Cycle - Play any visual effect a short distance in front of you at the floor, starts at 0000.
Dash Air + 1: Effect Cycle 2 - Identical to the Effect Cycle, but it starts at 1445. (AKA the start of 3D Model Effects in g3d > step > effect.)
Up + 1: Music Cycle - Play any music, starts at 0000.
Down + 1: Sound Cycle - Play any sound effect, starts at 0124. (The previous values are music, they share an ID system.)
Dash + 1: Attack Type Cycle - Spin the hammer around yourself and cycle through attack types/elements for the hitbox.
Hold 1, release: Infinite Invincibility - Become invincible permanently until you enter a new room. Good for getting through long gauntlets with ease.

Cycle Controls

Each of the "cycle" moves mentioned above mostly all have the same controls for navigating their ID system:

Up: Increase ID Value
Down: Decrease ID Value
B + Up: Increase ID Value by 10
B + Down: Decrease ID Value by 10
Hold 1: Pause Cycle (In case you wanted to see the full animation of an effect to see if it loops or preview music/sounds longer.)
A: End Cycle
Hold 1 (Attack Type Cycle): Manually Renew Attack
Hold 2 (Effect Cycle): Display the effect according to your direction. (Properly displays directional effects like sword slashes.)
Hold Minus (Effect Cycle): Display the effect at 0.5x scale (Can show you which effects scale and which that don't.)

Animation Cycle

Hold B before crouching to perform the "Animation Cycle". While not necessarily part of The Hamm_ERR, it's still included in this mod as something accessible by all characters and abilities to find the animations unique to each. Abilities can't play the animations from another, so it skips over all the invalid IDs. This can be a good tool for finding unused Animations with usable IDs that could be used for new custom animations for abilities. Since you have to hold down the entire time it's active, it has slightly different controls:

Right: Increase Value
Left: Decrease Value
B + Right: Increase Value by 10
B + Left: Decrease Value by 10
A: Jump to 0140, the final "common" animation before getting to the ones unique to each ability/character.
Release Down: End Cycle

profile._sText:
This mod replaces Kirby with a Bouncy, but it's not just a simple model import. Bouncy constantly jumps up and down regardless on whether you're pressing 2 or not. Bouncy generally makes the game a much trickier platformer and has a very limited set of techniques to get through every stage.

It's generally more challenging of a run considering how much less control you have over your own character, but Bouncy is no slouch, doing pretty solid damage when landing on enemies and being capable of breaking super ability-requiring gimmicks and bosses.

Alongside all this, Bouncy can't swim, completely ignoring all water as if it wasn't there. (Though the enemies ignore the water as well).

Moveset

  • Down: Spring Compress - The only way of stopping Bouncy from jumping, Is otherwise identical to normal crouching.
  • 2 While Falling: Spring Pulse - Very useful, as it's the only move capable of damaging things without landing directly onto them. It also gives you a little extra height, but can't be repeated for infinite height.
  • Down + 2: Safety Bound - Bouncy's own way of dodging attacks, she does a backflip while bouncing forward a bit. It also serves as a good "low" jump since all of her normal jumps at the highest possible height.
  • Hold Forward Against a Wall: Wall Rebound - A classic wall jump! Unlike Ninja's version, you don't cling to walls, Bouncy leaps off instantly. Combine it with a Spring Pulse and you can scale a single wall.

Gecko Code

This mod contains a large, preloaded Gecko Code in the main.dol file included in this mod, using it will likely overwrite the dol from other custom mods that have one. If you plan on mixing Bouncy with something else and want to avoid that, here's the Gecko Code itself that you can use instead:

profile._sText:
What used to be a low-effort reskin of Mike I privated out of embarrassment, I've repurposed into a superior Mike that functions like other copy abilities with a full, reusable moveset! I've always liked the idea of Mike finally becoming a more traditional ability, and thanks to modern advancements in hard-coding and Mint, I finally made it happen!

Moveset

  • 1: Desk Mike - Medium-ranged shockwave, it's the only move that can be used in the air.
  • Up + 1: EDM Pulse - Based on a Kirby Fangame's own custom "EDM" ability. Uppercut foes with a colorful audio visualizer, has an electrical element.
  • Charge EDM Pulse, Release: Tri-Pulse - three closely-packed visualizers, hits foes three times.
  • Dash + 1: Megaphone - Thin but long ranged beam.
  • Dash + Up + 1: Duet Notes - Fires two small notes at upwards angles, can be precise to land at times, but it does good damage.
  • Down + 1: Stand Mike - Large shockwave around yourself, it's slow to use, and somewhat weak, but it has invincibility frames.
  • Charge Stand Mike, Release: Encore - Slower to charge due to it being reusable and has a shorter range, but it's the strongest move in the moveset damage-wise.

Gecko Code

This mod uses ASM to make Mike's attacks reusable, so it includes a DOL file in the "sys" folder with the Gecko Code preinstalled, using it can overwrite other DOL files with Gecko Codes. If you plan on mixing this mod with others, here's the Gecko Code itself that you can use instead:

profile._sText:
Inside the animation file for Bandana Dee, there's animations referred to as "Horizontal Attack" where Bandana Dee crouches down and spins his spear in a circular motion. Unlike a lot of other cut animations in this game, these actually have ID values that can be loaded in Mint, meaning that these were cut later into development.

This mod essentially gives Bandana Dee a new "Down + 1" attack while on the ground, it has a short, low-to-the ground hitbox that reaches far in both directions. It has multihit properties that can trap foes for a while and it even includes invincibility frames! (Something Bandana Dee desperately needed, imo) Hold 1 and you can extend the duration of the move for a few seconds.

I made this a while back but never posted it! It's a very small mod,  but since it only add one move and only affects one animation script, so it's very compatible with other mods if you combine the extracted mint together.

Another thing to note, Spear Kirby has these same animation IDs which are just as usable, the only reason I didn't restore that as well was because in-game the animations themselves didn't look finished and was really clunky. Trying to fix the animations themselves wouldn't feel like a faithful restoration (plus I'm kinda bad at custom animations, lol.)

This mod's been a long time coming, I worked on it initially over two months ago and only just recently finished it! Dale's a very weak character with very poor damage and slow-to-use moves. Dale even comes with some preloaded Gecko Codes to both make Dedede to default Character, and give Dale a weak midair Jump instead of hovering!

Also included below the main download is an additional zip file containing custom KRtDL rooms that remove the dark filter from the dark areas. I felt that it was the easiest way of making Dale appropriately not be affected by darkness. It's optional though, feel free to make your life a little harder by not including them.

Moveset

  • Static Allergy (1) - Dale sneezes, releasing a small electric burst in front of him, this is one of Dale's most damaging moves, but is painfully slow to use. Holding 1 allows you to delay the sneeze however, and releasing it allows you to sneeze instantly, so it's better to plan your sneezes early and wait for your foes to come to you.
  • Skyward Light (Up + 1) - Based on Kirby's Adventure's Light Ability, Dale releases light particles that travel upward and turn into a small electric explosion above him. This move is best used for airborne bosses as it does very high damage by Dale's standards, otherwise it's useless against enemies at ground level.
  • Tail Flip (1 in Midair) - Dale simply does a front flip, attacking foes at pointblank range. It's Dale's fastest move, but with it's pitiful range and weak damage, it's best used only when other moves can't reach.
  • Intentional Trip (Dash + 1) - Dale trips over himself and lands on the ground. Before Dale face-plants the ground, he's invincible, allowing him to dodge through attacks he otherwise couldn't! Landing on the ground also has a small hitbox that only does 1 damage, so this move's best used exclusively for dodging and safely disposing of enemies.
  • Bulb Breaker (Dash + Minus) - Dale trips but breaks his bulb on impact, releasing a small electric field around himself for a second. It does high damage and also has invincibility at the start, but Dale gets up off the ground very slowly, leaving Dale defenseless for a while.
  • Taunt (Down + 1) - Dale happily hops around a few times, not much else to say.
(Both Skyward Light and Bulb Breaker have Super Ability properties, allowing Dale to get through Grand Doomer and Magolor's first phase.)

Gecko Codes

Dedede replaces all Characters
044e5954 38000005

Replace Hover with Weakened Air Jump
045215a0 4bff8064

Remove Dedede Grunt Noise from Hammer Throw
045bb624 60000000

Notes

I should note that Dale most certainly can't 100% the game, I'm not even sure if he can fully reach the end of the game on his own, but through the use of an exploit to gain infinite height, alternating between Air Jump and Tail Flip, you can get through most tough platforming challenges.

I firmly believe that all, or at least the majority of modders, start with a repaint. I was no different. Before I even had a Gamebanana account, I messed with textures via dolphin's custom texture loading system and created "Kirby's Sick Day". The 4 heroes were based on colors with humorous hex codes like 69b00b and b00b69.

I've actually used a lot that was in Sick Day for old mods. Aeon Kirby, Pre-Betrayal Magolor Palettes, and Gloomy Parasol all came from it. Even my first Gamebanana profile pic was based on Sick Kirby!

Unfortunately, for all that Sick Day started, it's currently lost media. A lot of textures were deleted after I redownloaded dolphin and didn't back up my "load" folder. This was before I knew how to edit models, so custom loading of textures was as much as I could do.

I couldn't even edit text at the time, though I still created """lore""" for it to joke around with friends. Magolor was aware of the multiverse with the multitude of KRtDL timelines. The Sick Day timeline was fully corrupt, hence the repainted textures, so he came to this one to purge it himself.

profile._sText:
What initially started as a simple mod that changed Meta Knight's HUD icon into Galacta Knight evolved into a big project to make the most polished "playable Galacta Knight Mod" on this site. Way back on July 24th 2021, I uploaded "Playable Galacta Knight: Dreamixed" with minor gameplay tweaks to make Galacta Knight play differently than normal Meta Knight, and with a harder Meta Knight as a boss fight over Galacta. A long time after releasing that mod, I've since learned more fancy code edits to completely revamp the moveset of both Galacta Knight and Meta Knight!

Galacta Knight

  • Galacta has more health, 50 instead of 36, and 25 in EX mode.
  • A lot of Galacta's physical attacks like sword slashes are capable of destroying Super Ability gimmicks and blocks. Even allowing him to get through the Grand Doomer and Magolor fights.
  • Galactic Slashes - Similar to Meta Knight's default sword combo, but much less forward momentum, making it a little safer to use against bosses. performing the full combo lets you use Crescent Shot at the end.
  • Disengage - Activated with Down + 1. Galacta Knight steps backwards to dodge attacks and stay away from foes. Hold Forward and 1 as it ends and you can perform Instant-Crescent Shot to use Multithrust and Decisive Slash without needing to go through the first three slashes in your default combo.
  • Piercing Lance - Has a slight delay to it compared to Meta Knight's own Piercing Slash, but hold 1 and you can delay it for a few extra seconds! Delay too long and you'll lose your invincibility until you release 1.
  • Warrior Chop - Similar to Meta Knight's Chop, but with purely vertical recoil, making it easier to chain together.
  • Thunderspines - While holding up and tapping 1 gives you a normal Up Thrust, hold 1 and you can perform Galacta Knight's signature attack, creating what are internally called "Thunderspines" to strike down lightning at specific ranges! Galacta creates one of three patterns, a spread shot of five, four close thunderspines, and two far away thunderspines at both sides. While it's random by default, you can control which pattern is used by holding up, down, or to the side on the D-Pad!
  • Revolution Sword - Hold Up and 1 in the air to use, it doesn't fully revolve around Galacta like the attack used in his boss fight, but this can still be used to sweep through foes below you!
  • Warrior Spin Shockwave - While the normal Aerial Dash attack is unchanged outside of the sound effect, Condor Dive is replaced with the longer spin attack that Galacta Knight normally uses where he shoots a shockwave from his lance upon landing! Unlike Condor Dive, you aren't invincible during the attack. The Shockwave itself travels further, and while there's only one of them, it also has the new ability to cool lava blocks!
  • Cyclone Slash - Just like Meta's own Spin Slash, it does good damage, and lets you stay invincible during it, this version simply gives more speed and is a little more controllable.
  • Mach Tornado - While charging Spin Slash, hold down as you release to perform this instead! While you sadly can't leave the ground, it's otherwise very similar to the Tornado Ability. It lets you move further with a longer duration than Spin Slash at the cost of less damage and no invincibility during the move. You can cancel it early by pressing 1. Just like the shockwave, it can cool lava blocks.
  • Down Thrust - Travels faster than Meta's version and you're invincible until you land. You can even pound wooden stakes with it!
  • Eruption - Hold 1 as you land with Down Thrust to create a pillar of fire in front of you. Hold forward as well, and the fire pillar spawns a little further from you. Good spacing is key to properly using this move! It's roughly based on the fire pillar attack that Galacta Knight uses in KSSU.
  • Shuttle Loop - It has a much higher top speed while gliding and doesn't slow down when moving at an upwards angle! It does have a major nerf in that invincibility from the move has been completely removed, as it could be used to cheese boss fights.
  • Water Spin - Unchanged from the normal attack when you tap 1. Hold 1 however, and you can instead perform an underwater version of Revolution Sword!
  • Flap - Galacta Knight flaps just a little faster than he runs, but without any starting deceleration, you can achieve much higher speeds by first using Shuttle Loop!
  • Combination Attack - With a friend piggybacking you, Galacta can use his own unique combination attack! It has the same sound and particle effects of Galacta Knight breaking out of his own crystal. It functions mostly pretty close to Dedede's own combination attack.

Pinch Mode

When Galacta Knight reaches low health, he'll enter "Pinch Mode" that allows him to perform improved versions of a few moves. While in this state, his idle, walk, and run animations are also changed to Galacta Knight floating above the ground instead of walking like in modern Kirby games.
  • Thunderspine's pattern will now always be a unique, screen-clearing pattern.
  • Eruption now uses 4 pillars, two on either side, to more closely resemble the KSSU attack it's based on.
  • You become invincible during Warrior Spin Shockwave.
  • You can delay Piercing Lance much longer.
  • Mach Tornado will last infinitely until you press 1.
  • Up Thrust now generates a small Thunderspine overhead, which can do a lot of damage when chained together.
  • Returns invincibility frames to Shuttle Loop, albeit for 10 extra frames after starting the glide instead of 30.

Dishonored Meta Knight

You can access this new battle without needing to go through the True Arena by taking a new Warpstar in the room before the Landia fight. Dishonored Meta Knight is a fearsome, aggressive boss with a lot of attacks that give you little reaction time, and with many special attacks that require you to dodge through them with invincibility frames.

The Battlefield itself is a new model featuring Final Destination from Super Smash Bros. Brawl. You fall through Another Dimension and in the background is the Halberd, albeit in terrible condition. A certain warrior cleanly sliced it in half, but such is life.

At around 80% of his health, Meta's mask breaks. Instead of running away, he only gets angrier and lets out a huge volley of Thunderspines and Sword Beam Rain before proceeding to Phase 2. He may even have a third phase, but I won't be spoiling it!
  • Many of Meta Knight's attacks will give him invincibility frames. If you can exploit them, so can he! Back Step, Spin Slash, Piercing Slash, and Mach Tornado all leave Meta invincible during the attack's duration.
  • The default sword combo that Galacta Knight uses, involving three slashes used twice, are now replaced with the more accurate Triple Slash > Multithrust > Decisive Slash combo used when playing as Meta Knight.
  • Piercing Slash is always used at the start of the fight, and has no delay like Galacta's version. Once again, this makes Meta unsafe to be close to.
  • Dishonored Meta can use Decisive Slash to create a Crescent Shot instantly, making it much less safe to stay close to him.
  • Dishonored Meta may use Sword Beam Rain in Phase 1, and returns to the ground faster while doing so. The Sword Beams from this attack also have a longer delay before reaching the ground, letting Meta Knight start attacking you while they rain down. In Phase 2, he may also mix Thunderspines into the attack.
  • Sword Beams have visually been replaced with Meta Knight's version, they have very little delay to them, so you still have to stay on your toes.
  • Crescent Shot is a little bigger and moves a little faster, just to make it a little harder to dodge.
  • Meta Knight's own Air Spin Shockwave attack is much faster, and since he uses it when you're above him, it's less safe to fly at the top of the screen. The projectile itself also moves faster.
  • Meta Knight has a new move, "Sword Beam Split", where he jumps into the air and fires 4 sword beams at slight angles, two on either side, to catch you if you decide to jump. In Phase 2, he will use Mach Tornado after shooting the sword beams.
  • Many attacks now utilize effects and hitboxes of the Spark Ability, with lightning appearing below Meta Knight during Sword Beam attacks and Mach Tornado, and upward lightning when using Giant Tornado.
  • Giant Tornado is now used twice in a row, and the tornadoes themselves moves much faster than before. In Phase 2, a third tornado is added after firing three sword beams in-between.
  • Revolution Sword now revolves around Meta Knight twice, and with some lightning above and below him, it requires invincibility frames to dodge. Meta Knight also uses this much faster by jumping directly to the center of the screen rather than flying up and back down to the center.

Other Miscellaneous Changes

  • The HUD has been recolored to match Galacta Knight's color scheme for all characters.
  • Pop Flowers, and various other character-specific colored items are now Deep Magenta.
  • The Subgames also have Meta replaced with Galacta. For Ninja Dojo, there's even a custom model for a Ninja Dojo Galacta Knight!
  • Pause Screen Desciptions for Meta, Galacta, and The Arena have been changed.
  • Title Screen music has been replaced with the Kirby Cafe remix of Galacta Knight's Theme.
  • Galacta Knight's music has been replaced with Star Allies remix of Nightmare's Theme.

Alternate Costumes

Just for fun, I've optimized a handful of Galacta Knight skins to make them easier to play as. Most are reused from other mods, but there's a handful of new ones as well:
  • Ninja Dojo Galacta Knight, I made a story mode version since I already made the custom model for the subgame.
  • Both versions of Aeon Hero.
  • Dishonored Meta Knight (And an unmasked version).
  • Morpho Knight from Kirby's Retro Dreamland.
  • Aeon Kirby, which was also my first mod.
  • Meta Knight's Galacta costume from Kirby Battle Royale.
  • Daredevil Galacta Knight from KRtDL: Daredevil Mode.
  • Rick Knight, a joke made a while back on my Discord Server.

Overview

This mod replaces Galacta Knight's model with Aeon Hero's model from Super Kirby Clash barring the wings which are just resized wings from Galacta Knight's original model. Additionally, Aeon Hero also has a custom, pink background for the fight that doesn't replace any other backgrounds!

Parameter Changes

  • 1425 Hp, Phase 2 starts sooner, Mach Tornado is slightly faster.
  • Moon Shot and the Shockwave projectiles are larger.
  • Sword Beams have a longer delay before they accelerate.
  • Revolution Beam revolves much much faster, be ready for it or you might not be able to outrun it.

AI Changes/Attack Tweaks

  • Giant Tornado comes out much faster, always be ready to dodge it when Aeon Hero flies to the side.
  • Both versions of Spin Slash have much shorter charge time and covers more distance.
  • Aeon Hero now uses Triple Moon Shot in Phase 1
  • He will always use Triple Moon Shot instead the Singular Moon Shot.
  • He may use Mach Tornado if the targeted hero is high in the air.
  • The move used for opening Phase two is now a whole new move instead of just Triple Thunderspines.
  • After using Giant Tornado, Galacta will use Up Thrust to make standing next to him more dangerous.

Moveset Changes

  • The "Easy" Thunderspine attack is now the vanilla "Hard" version
  • "Hard" Thunderspine attack now has two waves of thunderspines interrupted by a wave of sword beams.
  • Sword Beam Rain also includes waves of Thunderspines before the sword beams hit the arena. Afterwards, a second wave of Sword Beams are spawned.
  • Clock Beams (replaces Triple Thunderspines): Galacta, in the center of the screen, creates 12 sword beams at equal angles in a chaotic order, making them harder to predict.
  • Phase 2 Opener: 4 Thunderspines, Sword Beams, 4 Thunderspines, and then Clock Beams

Aeon Hero Dark

Aeon Hero Dark is very similar to Aeon Hero Light, only with a handful of small differences to make the fight even harder.
  • 2500 Hp and Phase 2 starts as soon as he takes any damage.
  • Revolution Beam revolves further than before, baiting the direction of the beam is mandatory if you can't use a move with invincibility frames.
  • Instead of creating a Shockwave after Air Spin, Aeon Hero Dark creates a Giant Tornado.
  • Sword Beam Rain is shortened but the Thunderspines are harder to dodge.
  • Phase 2 Opener is extended to include more Thunderspines and Revolution Beam.

profile._sText:
This mod comes with four colors of 8-Bit Kirbys. The model itself has 3D limbs, even with a custom toon shader outline to them! There's a flat texture for the face, but also textures for flight and inhaling. Some bugs include that the textures don't work on the title screen, only appearing on part of the warpstar, effects often appearing in front of the model instead of behind, and the inability to have textures flip when facing the other direction. These bugs are all visual though.

The real utility of this however, is that you can easily swap out textures on the model to create your own 2D kirby skin in seconds! Open up the model in Brawlbox/Brawlcrate, navigate to the "Textures(NW4R)" folder inside, right click each texture, and hit "replace" to change it to something else! Keep in mind that KRtDL doesn't really like super high quality textures, so I wouldn't go above 256x256 pixels or so. Also try to keep the textures in 1:1 aspect ratio or it will stretch to become square when on the model instead.

If you want to play without the limbs or without the toon shader outlines, navigate to 3DModels(NW4R) > Model > Objects and delete p0_Limbs or p6_LimbOutline respectively. Warnings will appear, asking you if you want to also delete some other stuff like vertex nodes and maybe materials, say yes to all of them if you want the model to work properly!

profile._sText:
This mod replaces Bandana Dee's model with Susie from Kirby Planet Robobot! Normally Susie doesn't use a spear, but I wanted her to replace Bandana Dee so that Spear Copter could use her Helicopter Transporter from Planet Robobot. If you're curious, the Cyber Spear that Susie Uses is just a modified model of Metal General EX's blade with an extended hilt and a smaller blade to simulate a spear.

Parameter Changes

Spear Thrust and Spear Multithrust no longer have recoil on them, making it safer to use against bosses.
Pinpoint Thrust, which follows Multithrust, is the opposite and has more recoil to it to charge through small lines of foes. Using it on a boss isn't recommended, as you'll likely just get yourself hurt.
Spear Throw now uses Susie's Dollys, the little drones used in her boss fight during Planet Robobot. They aren't thrown from her hand but instead appear above her to rain downwards at her enemies. When used on the ground, the move launches Susie forward further than normal.
Triple Throw launches Three Dolly's at three separate downward angles. It also has some upward recoil to it, allowing you to combo Triple Throw into Spear Barrage.
Spear Barrage's Dollys are thrown at a slightly slower rate but also slow your descent more in order to counteract it.
Moon Drop has little to no startup and travels downward much faster, however, it can't be jump-cancelled nearly as early.
Spear Copter lasts infinitely and accelerates vertically a little faster.

Mint Coding Changes

All of the attacks utilizing Susie's Cyber Spear now have an electric effect rather than the usual "sharp" effect used to cut ropes.
Spear Throw no longer allows you to step along the ground while charging the attack.
Spear Copter's hitbox has been moved to visually match up with the higher blades on the Transporter. This however is a nerf. The hitbox is now heavily disjointed from Susie, which leaves her open to attacks.

Parallel Susie

Turns out that Parallel Susie from Team Kirby Clash Deluxe is, unsurprisingly, just a retextured version of normal Susie, so it was really easy to make an alt from it. I've included her as an alternate skin in the zip file below.

profile._sText:
Honestly, this ability definitely isn't the same as Suplex from games like Kirby Star Allies or Kirby Super Star, changing Kirby's moves altogether would take a lot of effort and is beyond my own skill.

However, I tried by hardest through param edits to make the ability have the same "feel" as Suplex with hard-hitting, "grounded" moves and heavy emphasis on melee attacks.

Suplex Moveset:
  • All "quick tap" moves like Vulcan Jab and Sweep Kick are completely inaccessible, but "hold button" moves like Smash Punch and Rising Break come out a few frames earlier.
  • Fury Punch and Fury Kick - Both have less range than Smash Punch and Double Kick, forcing you to get closer to use them.
  • Turbo Dash Kick - Moves further horizontally than Spin Kick but doesn't move vertically.
  • Heavy Uppercut - A short range, horizontal version of Rising Break, that allows for quick getaways from boss attacks.
  • Pile Driver and German Suplex - Much like Arm Throw and Judo Throw but with more force and recoil.
  • Torrent Lariat - A unique Up Throw for Suplex! It sends foes backwards at a high angle.
  • Roaming Valor - Travels slower than Force Blast
  • Stalling Resolve - Travels much slower than Mega Force Blast.
  • Flash Firestorm - Travels much faster than Giga Force Blast.
  • Pinpoint Kick - Suplex's most popular move that doesn't involve grabs, it travels directly downward.

Graphical Changes:
  • Fighter's headband is replaced with Suplex's headband from Kirby Star Allies
  • The Fighter ability star has been retextured with a new custom texture based off of the icon from Kirby Star Allies
  • Most if not all other references to Fighter have been replaced with Suplex.
  • Only Spin Kick and Rising Break have new blueish effects to them as the others looked weird with new colors.

Backdrop Ability:

New to the 2.0 Update is a set of files that replace Suplex with the more retro Backdrop Ability. Backdrop serves both as a palette swap for Suplex as well as having several notable gameplay differences:
  • Fury Kick - "Lingering Kick" stays on screen longer, allowing it to hit multiple times.
  • Pinpoint Kick - "Flying Kick" is closer to normal Fighter's Sky Kick only that it moves at a wider 45 degree angle.
  • Heavy Uppercut - "Zealous Uppercut" travels further and allows you to act out of the move faster at the cost of some invincibility frames.
  • German Suplex - "Backdrop" has more force to the throw without any recoil to it.
  • Roaming Valor - "Brash Valor" - travels faster rather than slower.
  • Stalling Resolve - "Violent Resolve" - travels much faster rather than much slower, and has a lot of recoil.
  • Flash Firestorm - "Crawling Firestorm" - travels slower rather than faster and has significant recoil.

This is basically Needle+

This mod makes a the Needle ability broken mostly by making many moves faster to execute. The specific changes are as follows:

-- Needle Attack and Mega Needle both come out at almost frame 1 and each have little to no ending lag.
--Rolling Needle Now will last indefinitely until 1 is pressed again.
--Needle Burst requires less shaking of the Wii-Remote to be executed, allowing it to be easily spammed.

It took a while to reverse-engineer the params for Needle, but it wasn't so bad considering Needle only has four moves. Regardless, please enjoy this mod!

Programs used

  • Paint.net (editing the textures)
  • Wexos's Toolbox (decompressing\compressing archive.bin in the param folder)

profile._sText:
Kirby's Retro Dreamland is a graphical overhaul that stylizes RTDL after the cancelled Kirby GCN as well as other Kirby games released around the time that game was announced. 

It features
  • Both new and edited models for all characters and items
  • Characters that were not seen in RTDL such as Bio Spark, Plasma Wisp, and lost enemies from Kirby GCN replacing the original cast of RTDL
  • Retextured stages to make the game feel fresh
  • Alternate model options like Clean replacing the Spear ability (Though Clean remains functionally identical to Spear)
  • Only the graphics have been changed as gameplay still remains 100% the same.

If you are interested in only the recreations of Kirby GCN models then you can download them (as well as other Kirby GCN model recreations that are not featured in this mod such as Wheelie, Wheel Kirby, etc.) here. Feel free to use them/modify them however you like as long as you give credit.

NOTE: I've updated the mod to fix Whispy Woods' eyes and the final bosses fire effects being invisible, sorry for the long wait and thanks for your patience.

This simple mod lets you play as the otherwise cutscene exclusive model of Klonoa from the very start of the game.
Normally, this model lacks the three bones related to the ring, causing the game to crash if you were to pick up an enemy.
This adds those bones back, as well as whatever his right "mabu" bone for his head is, making it identical to the normal skeleton.

Now, you can experience the land of dreams while donning the most fitting sleeping gear.
Don't ask why, it was the only model you couldn't normally use.

profile._sText:
-Manhunt 2 AO Edition for Wii-

The Wii's most violent game is now even more violent!

The aim of this mod is to restore all of the changes Rockstar made, in order to secure an M rating and an 18 rating from the BBFC. 

What are the changes made?

-Execution filters have been removed (no red hinting either).

-Head explosions are possible in executions and melee combat, with all weapons supporting it.

-Head decaps are possible in executions and melee combat, with all weapons supporting it.

Can you import stuff from the PC version (ie, uncensored dialog, weapons, etc)?

This is something I am interested in doing, however, after analysing the files of both versions, particularly audio files, they are very different and would take a lot of work to import. For the moment, however, I'm focused on restoring aspects that still remain in the files, and don't require reversing files from different platforms.#

I'm getting a black screen after enabling the mod in Riivolution...

If you're using an SD card, it needs to be fast enough to process the files that need patching. If it's not fast enough, your game will likely crash. There are two ways of fixing this: get a new SD card that is of a faster transfer speed, or use Riivolution and install the mod using a USB drive. If you're still having issues, and you know your installation is correct, feel free to contact me on discord: Connorrr(miserable)#9485.

Special thanks to:

Assembly Community Discord server, for programming support (I am horrible with Assembly code...)

Ermaccer, for creating the censorship removal patch for PSP, and whose source code helped me understand exactly what needed editing (none of their source code was used).

My friends (Jodie, Ash & Korrin), who watched me develop this like some mad scientist, and showing their support.

Rockstar Vienna, for laying the groundwork and developing a decent chunk of Manhunt 2 (Credits for their hard work: https://www.intelligent-artifice.com/2007/11/rockstar-viennas-missing-credits-for-manhunt-2.html)

For the most recent version available, go to the GitHub page here:
https://github.com/ConnorrrGaming/Manhunt_2_AO_Edition_For_Wii

profile._sText:
Dead City is a 3 mission campaign by Daniel101.  Version 1.2 contains network optimization for mission 3. See change log. More info at homepage

Original Description:
Mission Briefing
Syntek have a serious problem they have an important director stuck in the city. He is held up in a Syntek building, completely over run by the swarm. You have to walk him out of there. I'm sure you know already but Omega city is infested by the swarm. Its population is all but dead except a few lucky people who escaped in time. Don't expect to have a peaceful time and let me stress this, Syntek do not want this guy to be killed so don't let it happen marines! I trust you will get the job done.

Background 
Omega City is probably the largest settlement away from Earth, it had a popuation of about 3 million. The planet it is on is a very earthlike planet called Freedom's Chance which is in the Falcon system. The planets climate is very similar to earths but the planet is mostly ocean with only one continent. The planet was discovered after the survey ship Freedom looking for vauable minerals on a nearby planet stumbled across it by accident after a problem with their engine forced them towards the planet. Freedom's Chance has 14 moons all rich in minerals which provided enough minerals to build up a city 50 times the size of Omega. The colony built up rapidly many people looking for a new start left for there. The city set up many factories using all the raw materials from the moons to create items that were then sold in Earth making the colony very rich and propserous. 20 years after this the swarm destroyed the city's popuation it is still unknown how it got on the planet. One month after this your squad is ordered to help extract a SynTek director from the city, why he stayed in the city is unknown to you. 

Change log:
v. 1.2
- Added network optimization for mission 3 (Search and Rescue). Reduced network traffic up to 10 times.
- Included NAV and AIN files

Entrance is a quite innovative map, with lots of stuff that you can't see anywhere else. Lot's of triggers and stuff that changes gameplay a little.

Story - an AI studying aliens inside a facility went rogue. You need to check what exactly happened. This is first mission of a possible future campaign. Objective is to find a secret facility hidden in mountains. You arrive at small power and storage station and go from there.

It's a second map I've made (first called The Investigation, that was kind of an experiment). This one is kind of better, I already knew how to make most of the stuff and I just focused on enchancing the standard gameplay, and hopefully make something new. I'm proud of some features that I included in it.

Map still have some small minor bugs, like lack of image of campaign (somehow JPG file doesn't work, tried all kinds of stuff to no avail).
Game engine doesn't really like elevators that much, but it is still possible to solve the map even alone - already did that, though on easy difficulty. 4 Players should have no problem. 

If you find anything you think that should be fixed, plz tell me and I'll fix most serious issues. Random stuttering during elevators/train (that doesn't happen often) are not my fault though, game just doesn't like changing moving objects that much :)

Map is quite cool, I recommend 3 - 4 players, but you can easily play it even alone - as long as you choose easy difficulty ( I managed even without sentry gun).

Tears for Tarnor, v0.10

Welcome to the harsh planet of Tarnor.
A nearly airless rock circling an ancient Red Giant, the planet is subject to baking heat in the day and freezing colds at night.
Despite the unforgiving nature of the planet, the bustling colony of Oasis thrives on the surface as a major trading hub. It's often been said that whatever you need you can find it at Oasis, for a price.
However, the colony has recently lost it's voice, and it's heartbeat wanes, as something sinister has hatched deep within the research labs, in a project known only to a very few.
Recently, all comm. traffic from Tarnor has mysteriously ceased, as such the IAF have sent in a squad to investigate why Oasis has lost it's voice.

===

08/01/2010
Got rid of the airlock doors.
Players take around 5 damage each time an alien makes it to the end, bring a medic if you need one.
Mines cannot be thrown from the bridges.
Fixed spawn issues with wave 10 and on.
Map should be basically done, still calling it beta because I need to see how easy/hard the waves are, and where it lags.
Again, feedback will help me reach a final map faster.

7/29/2010:
Fixed aliens in wave 8 stopping when gaining eye sight on marines
Lowered path walls for easier aiming at aliens
Mines can now be deployed on alien path. (mines cannot be thrown over railings on bridge)

Update 07/28/2010
Got rid of ranger aliens.
Increased spawn durations for lag
Now 20 levels of alien horde
Added player clip so players cannot fall into the path

Larger spawn, more spawners spread out more
Added another enterance to maze
Fixed bridges because of clipping issues
Added a bridge overlooking the airlock door, making it easier to clear aliens there

Update 07/28/2010
Added more unique lighting.
Made a more realistic bridge to travel from platform to platform.
Added a few decals for some eye candy.
Waves remain the same.


This is my first map, I wanted to go with a tower defense, but the sentry guns would keep running out of ammo, and I didn't want to drop a million sentry gun stashes, so I made a Marine Defense map.

Objective: Prevent the horde of aliens from reaching the airlock doors, once the doors are breached, its GG for the marines. There are currently only around 10 waves.

Notes:

Grenade Launchers make the game too easy, if you want it to be more challenging, use a different gun. Also Trip mines and Fire Wall mines wont deploy on the alien path.

I couldn't figure out how to get the resupply entity to work, so the ammo drops everywhere are just a temporary thing. 

Lastly, I could care less if you decompile my map and gut it up. I actually prefer this as long as it is helping the mapping community. The goal of this map was to start Defense maps, whether it be Tower/Marine. All I ask is you provide credit where credit is due.

Currently I have no readme in there, so to install just copy the vpk file into your swarm/addon folder and then enable it in-game by going to option>addons and checking the box.

Going to continue to add more waves, and edit previous ones to make them harder/stronger/faster or weaker/slower/easier depending on feedback.

FEEDBACK IS NEEDED! Again this is my first map EVER so any productive feedback is appreciated.

Here's my first map, and the first Alien Swarm map on FPSBanana.
I wanted to get this out so that people can start testing it and telling me about any glitches in gameplay or otherwise. Please, if you find any glitches post on here and inform me of them, so that I can fix it in later versions. No bug is too small!


Things to fix:
Balance - Some difficulty due to alien grouping.
Bugs - Any problems you find I want to fix, so tell me!
Players do not gain XP - Valve has de-activated XP for custom maps, so I cannot fix this as of now. Players still gain achievements!
Online play does not work currently.


ChangeLog - From a1 to a2
Fixed alien spawn - The trigger was moved closer to player spawn
Fixed missing textures
Balanced the map some.
Fixed some tiles not aligning with others correctly.
Fixed download directory.


ChangeLog - From a2 to a3
Did overview - Currently not working
Packed into VPK - Huge pain in the bum
Fixed a few bugs - I inadvertently left a few areas open where players could fall through.

ChangeLog - From a3 to a5
Closed off some gaps in the map - Prevents players from falling through.
Copied some brushes and models - Also created some new geometry to fill gaps.
Textured some brushes - More to come!

ChangeLog - From a5 to a55
Fixed online play - Half an update, so only half a digit change (5.5)

Unzip the file to Alien Swarm > Swarm > addons, then just enable the "Heat Stroke" addon under the game's options.

To play you have to type "map asi-heatstroke-a5" in console. To play with bots, first you have to open tutorial mode, close it, and then type "map asi-heatstroke-a5" in console.

profile._sName: Star Wars Mod v2.0 - Special Edition
profile._sText:
Star Wars Mod v2.0 is a total conversion mod for Aliens vs Predator 2 Primal Hunt. It is easily the biggest mod for AvP2 (as of time of release) and Primal Hunt (as of time of release) in that in changes nearly 5,800 files and overhauls nearly the entire look and feel of the game.

The mod began as a sound and music pack, but I kept building upon it until it became the massive total conversion that it is now. The primary theme for the mod is the original trilogy and expanded universe (pre-Disney).

This mod is completely client side as there are no gameplay changes at all. This is an intentional design choice as it was made to work on any multiplayer server that isn't blocking skins, which should be 99% of them. The only exception to this rule are the multiplayer custom maps, as all players will need the maps in order to play them. These maps are already included in UMP3 for those who have it already.

Furthermore, this mod will overhaul the game in both singleplayer and multiplayer. The most dramatic change that players will immediately notice is that everything looks and sounds different. While many players will use this mod in multiplayer, I recommend replaying the single player campaigns as well for a new experience. I can guarantee that players will find new surprises in their playthroughs.

Enjoy!

profile._sText:
This is a small mod that will replace the Primal Hunt campaign missions of the corporate, ancient predator and predalien with the AvP2 campaign missions of the marine, predator and alien. If you have already beaten the Primal Hunt campaign missions, you will see the first three missions from the AvP2 campaigns unlocked. As you progress through them, the rest of the AvP2 campaigns will unlock as usual.

The benefits of running this mod is being able to play the original AvP2 campaigns with Primal Hunt's new features such as dual pistols, sentry guns, predalien headbite, ancient predator, energy flechette, etc. It should be noted that even when playing as a marine in single player, any sentry guns you place down will not fire on any corporates. However, the sentry guns do fire upon the aliens and predators. As for playing as the predalien or ancient predator, you will need to utilize the cheat codes to morph into these characters. I've included a list of cheat codes as well to help with this.

PLEASE NOTE: 

The AvP2 marine campaign requires the player to use the hacking tool and torch. These are disabled in Primal Hunt by Third Law. You can solve this by doing one of the following:

1. RECOMMENDED SOLUTION:

Download and install the "master server patch" for Primal Hunt. It can be found at any of the following mirrors:

https://avpunknown.com/avp2master/

https://www.moddb.com/mods/avp2-primal-hunt-master-server-patch

https://www.nexusmods.com/aliensvspredator2/mods/805

This patch will restore your hacking tool and torch.

2. You can unlock the torch via an edit to your autoexec.cfg file. I have a tutorial on how to do that here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=09H5lhOKKWI

https://www.bitchute.com/video/UgAn0ujZhCZP/

https://bittube.tv/post/bd79b16d-0efe-4547-a523-37174c03b304

https://odysee.com/@KingKenny:9/Primal-Hunt-Tutorial---How-to-use-the-torch-in-AvP2-Primal-Hunt:e

However, you will still need to cheat to get past sections that require the hacking tool.

3. Bypass most torch and hacking tool sections by using the cheat <mpsixthsense> to free fly through the map.

Backstory:

 

After playing Brutal Doom for several weeks and then returning to AvP2, I thought "AvP2 doesn't have enough gore in it." Thus, I decided to review what blood mods were available for AvP2 and realized there was only one called "Juicy Gore Mod". While that mod is cool, I thought it had a few problems and I wanted to do a gore mod with a different approach altogether that would satisfy my lust for blood in AvP2. While making breakfast one day (I'm serious and I don't know why I thought this while making breakfast) it suddenly hit me. "I could increase the size of the blood and gibs (guts)". I then started the mod right away and expanded upon the original idea.

What this mod does in a nutshell:

Blood n' Guts Mod is a gore mod for AvP2 and the expansion pack Primal Hunt. It increases the size of all the blood splats, blood droplets, gibs/guts/chunks of meat and bone. Essentially all the gore is ramped up. However, the gore level isn't too unrealistic and it's not not too tame either. The gore level is at a nice sweet spot where you will feel like there is more carnage and mayhem, without completely obstructing your screen with blood.

Different versions of the mod:

Blood n' Guts Mod comes in eight versions depending on what other mods you're running and what master server you're connecting to for online play. Four of the versions are the full mod, while the other four are reduced versions that exclude the FX.txt attributes file. For those not familiar with modding, the FX.txt file controls many of the special effects (FX) you see in the game such as drips, sprays, smoke, fire, particles, etc.

Please choose the appropriate rez file accordingly. Rez files 1 - 4 are for AvP2. Rez files 5 - 8 are for Primal Hunt. Rez files 5 - 8 can actually work with AvP2, but there might be a possibility of these rez files causing a conflict with AvP2 and they might cause a game crash. I can't confirm this though. Also the Predalien skin will look different in the AvP2 and Primal Hunt versions of the mod.

1. BLOODNGUTS.rez - This is the full mod. This will work with AvP2 single player (v1.0.9.6) and AvP2 multiplayer using Master Server Patch v2.4 (MSP 2.4) or higher as long as future versions of MSP don't restrict the FX.txt attributes file from being edited to join a server. This should also work with any mod that doesn't have a FX.txt attributes file in it. This version of the mod can work in lan games only if the host and all joining players have the same mod running.

2. BLOODNGUTS_NOFX.rez - This is the reduced version of the mod that excludes the FX.txt attributes file. You will still see the big gibs and blood splats, but no fancy special effects on blood sprays or droplets. Use this version if you're trying to connect to a different master server (like an official server), trying to join a lan game not running the full Blood n' Guts mod or if you're running another mod that already has an FX.txt attributes file in it. Of course if you just don't like the special effects in the full mod, you can run this version to play single player or multiplayer on any master server.

3. BLOODNGUTS_SW.rez - This is the exact same mod as # 1, the full Blood n' Guts Mod, but it's designed to be fully compatible with my "Star Wars Mod v2.0 - Special Edition". In that mod, I made the synthetics human and gave them red blood. So in this version of Blood n' Guts Mod, the synthetics will remain human and have red blood.

4. BLOODNGUTS_SW_NOFX.rez - This version is a mix of # 2 and # 3. If you want everything listed in # 2, but want it to be compatible with "Star Wars Mod v2.0 - Special Edition" as listed in # 3, use this one.

5. BLOODNGUTSPH.rez - This is the full mod. This will work with Primal Hunt single player (v1.0.2.2F) and Primal Hunt multiplayer using Master Server Patch 1.0 (MSP 1.0) or higher as long as future versions of MSP don't restrict the FX.txt attributes file from being edited to join a server. This should also work with any mod that doesn't have a FX.txt attributes file in it. This version of the mod can work in lan games only if the host and all joining players have the same mod running.

6. BLOODNGUTSPH_NOFX.rez - This is the reduced version of the mod for Primal Hunt. It excludes the FX.txt attributes file. You will still see the big gibs and blood splats, but no fancy special effects on blood sprays or droplets. Use this version if you're trying to connect to a different master server (like an official server), trying to join a lan game not running the full Blood n' Guts mod or if you're running another mod that already has an FX.txt attributes file in it. Of course if you just don't like the special effects in the full mod, you can run this version to play single player or multiplayer on any master server.

7. BLOODNGUTSPH_SW.rez - This is the exact same mod as # 5, the full Blood n' Guts Mod, but it's designed to be fully compatible with my "Star Wars Mod v2.0 - Special Edition" for Primal Hunt. In that mod, I made the synthetics human and gave them red blood. So in this version of Blood n' Guts Mod, the synthetics will remain human and have red blood.

8. BLOODNGUTSPH_SW_NOFX.rez - This version is a mix of # 6 and # 7. If you want everything listed in # 6, but want it to be compatible with "Star Wars Mod v2.0 - Special Edition" for Primal Hunt as listed in # 7, use this one.

These rez files will be abbreviated as #s 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 and 8 in the changelog below.

Changelog

v1.1

A) Primal Hunt:

1) Added support for the Primal Hunt expansion pack.

a) The following changes from v1.0 carry over to rez files 5 through 8 for Primal Hunt:

- Menus (differs in rez files # 7 and # 8 for Star Wars Mod v2.0 compatibility).

- Textures.

- Models.

- Attributes (exludes rez files 6 and 8).

B) Textures:

1) Predalien textures altered to swap the green blood with a 50/50 blend of the green predator blood and yellow alien blood.

a) Rez files 1 - 4 use the AvP2 predalien texture with the new blood.

b) Rez files 5 - 8 use the Primal Hunt predalien texture with the new blood.

c) The end result will have the blood on the predalien match the blood splats and fx better.

C) Attributes/Code:

This only applies to rez files 1, 3, 5 and 7.

1) Alien large blood droplets have been tweaked to be 8X as many, but half the size.

2) Human large blood droplets have been tweaked to be 8X as many, but half the size.

3) Predator large blood droplets have been tweaked to be 8X as many, but half the size.

4) Synthetic large blood droplets have been tweaked to be x8 as many, but half the size.

5) Praetorian sparks increased 8X.

a) Standard pistol ammo will produce the new sparks. AP pistol ammo will produce blood.

v1.0

A) Menus:

1) New splash screen (differs in rez files # 3 and # 4 for Star Wars Mod v2.0 compatibility).

2) New splash sound (removed in rez files # 3 and # 4 for Star Wars Mod v2.0 compatibility).

B) Textures:

1) Alien debris/gib and blood textures upscaled 2X - 8X depending on the texture.

2) Human debris/gib and blood textures upscaled 2X - 8X depending on the texture.

3) Predator debris/gib and blood textures upscaled 2X - 8X depending on the texture.

4) Synthetic debris/gib and blood textures upscaled 2X - 8X depending on the texture.

C) Models:

1) Alien debris/gib models upscaled 2X.

2) Human debris/gib models upscaled 2X.

3) Predator debris/gib models upscaled 2X.

4) Synthetic debris/gib models upscaled 2X.

5) Egg debris/gib models upscaled 2X.

6) Exosuit debris/gib models upscaled 2X.

D) Attributes/Code:

This only applies to rez files 1 and 3.

1) Alien stump blood spew ramped up 64X and will fade out after character death.

2) Human neck blood spew ramped up 64X and will fade out after character death.

3) Predator neck blood spew ramped up 64X and will fade out after character death.

4) Synthetic neck blood spew ramped up 64X and will fade out after character death.

5) Alien blood droplets ramped up 4X and 8X.

6) Human blood droplets ramped up 4X and 8X.

7) Predator blood droplets ramped up 4X and 8X.

8) Synthetic blood droplets ramped up 4X and 8X.

9) Skinned corpse bodies ("hanging human") have blood droplets 1.5X larger and 2X the amount of droplets.

Trooper Style Skirmish - Version 1.1

This map originally was part of the Imp Co-Op mod by Imp Hunter. I have had a few requests to have it released with AI Marines to aid the Player in Single Player Skirmish, so here it is.

If you haven't tried out the Imp Co-Op Mod, then give it a shot. The latest version '2.something' is now available to download:

http://aliensvspredator2.filefront.com/file/Imp_Coop_V2something;63941

Gameplay:

This is a Marine only Single Player only version of the Trooper Style map that appears in the Imp Co-Op mod. To Play this map in Multiplayer, go and download the mod.

Many small changes have been made to this map to cater for Single Player Skirmish including the addition of 3 Marine helper bots to assist defend the stockade. To have them follow the Player, select them the way you would use a door and they will follow you. Selecting them a second time will order them to stop and stand their ground. They may not be perfect, but certainly are better than nothing.

To start the Alien AI swarm, access the compound's upper wall walkway and open both of the Ammo boxes found there. The AI will only trigger once both boxes have been selected. The boxes can then be selected as usual but have no effect on the AI. Once the Aliens start their attack, the stockade doors will not re-open.
