profile._sText:
Item Fever is a Mario Kart Wii mod that adds 21 brand-new items to the game, each with its own model, sounds and behavior, and reworks four of the original items. Every new item works for you, for the CPUs, in Grand Prix, in VS races and (when it makes sense) in Battle mode.

It runs on your own copy of Mario Kart Wii (all regions: European PAL, American NTSC-U, Japanese NTSC-J and Korean), on a real Wii or on Dolphin, through Riivolution. Your original save is never touched. Offline only: online play and the Mario Kart Channel are disabled.

New items

  • Giant Banana (from Double Dash): a huge banana. Hit it and you spin out twice (even if you use a Mega Mushroom), while it bursts into three regular bananas. Shells break on it (except the Bowser Shell).
  • Bowser Shell (from Double Dash): a giant spiked shell that flips karts over, makes them drop their item and keeps rolling. It even spins out karts using a Mega Mushroom.
  • Mega Thunder Cloud: the opposite of the Thunder Cloud. After 6 seconds, it gives its carrier the Mega Mushroom effect. Bump into someone to pass it on. Carrying it gives no speed boost (the classic version, with its speed boost, can be chosen in Mod Settings).
  • Boo: steals a random rival's item, anywhere in the race, and turns you into an invisible ghost for 7.5 seconds.
  • Explosive Shell: a green shell carrying a lit Bob-omb. It bounces like a green shell and explodes on contact. You are immune to its explosion for 1.5 seconds after throwing it.
  • Ice Flower: throws three ice balls, forward or backward. Anyone hit is frozen in a block of ice for 2 seconds.
  • Giga Mushroom: bigger than the Mega Mushroom. Crush everyone in your way, including Mega karts. For the last places only.
  • Feather: jump on command! Take shortcuts, dodge red and blue shells with good timing, or land on a rival to squash them. The racer in 1st place has a small chance of getting one.
  • Boonana: a banana rivals can only see when they get close to it.
  • Banzai Bill: a Bullet Bill three times bigger and 50% faster.
  • Rock Mushroom: turns you into a rolling boulder for 5 seconds. Knock over everything you hit; every hit resets the timer. Press the item button or drift to end it early.
  • Rainbow Mushroom: a boost that makes you invincible while it lasts, faster than a Star.
  • Boo Mushroom: a ghostly boost. Nothing can touch you, and driving through a rival steals their item: the one in their item slot first, or the one they are holding if their slot is empty.
  • Purple Shell: a much faster green shell when thrown forward. It breaks on the first wall, and long shots earn you a Mushroom.
  • Pull Star: shoot a star at a rival; if it hooks on, it pulls you toward them. The longer the shot, the higher and faster the flight. You can steer during the flight.
  • Chain Chomp: let loose a Chain Chomp that charges up the track, zigzagging from side to side, and knocks over everyone it touches. It lasts 10 seconds, and you are immune to your own Chain Chomp for the first 4 seconds. Hold down when throwing to send it backward (it then lasts 4 seconds).
  • Snowball: a snowball that grows bigger as it rolls, and keeps rolling until it passes the racer in 1st place. Throwing it gives you a super slipstream, twice as long as the normal one.
  • Penguin Suit: a fast but fragile transformation. Freeze rivals on contact and ignore slippery ground. Each rival you freeze makes the suit last a bit longer (never beyond its starting duration). You can't drift, but steering is a bit easier. Press the item button to end it early.
  • "?" Block: a block appears in the air ahead of you, and you get a Feather to reach it. Hit it to get a random item (never a Lightning, Golden Mushroom, POW Block, Bullet Bill, Banzai Bill, Giga Mushroom, Boo, Feather, Chain Chomp, Snowball, Penguin Suit or Black Shell). The racer in 1st place has a very small chance of getting one.
  • Kamek's Wand: turn rival karts into Goombas for 3 seconds: they drive as slowly as when shrunk by a Lightning, and can't drift or use items. It also works on shells and bananas. Hold the button to charge a triple shot.
  • Black Shell: it flies to 1st place like a Blue Shell, with an alarm everyone can hear, and a much bigger explosion that throws karts four times higher. Its blast wave also pushes away the karts around it.

Reworked items

Each reworked item can be switched back to its original version in Mod Settings > Gameplay, and a small spark marks their icons (it can be hidden in Mod Settings > Graphics).
  • Thunder Cloud: now an attack. Throw it and it flies over everything to land on the head of the racer just ahead of you. They have 6 seconds to pass it on before the lightning strikes and shrinks them for 5 seconds. Carrying it gives no speed boost.
  • Golden Mushroom: one single, very powerful boost (top speed 170 in 150cc, 2.5 seconds) with a trail of flames, instead of a series of small boosts.
  • Fake Item Box: it now looks exactly like a real item box, with an upside-down question mark, and only reveals itself as a fake when a rival gets close. Drive through an item box while holding it (no need to press the item button), and it takes that box's place, even moving like the original box if it was moving.
  • Bob-omb: explodes on impact. It blows up as soon as it hits the ground, instead of waiting there on a long fuse.
  • Blooper: removed by default. It can be turned back on in Mod Settings > Gameplay.

Also new

  • Items are held in hand: your held item no longer protects you from behind (the original behavior can be brought back in Mod Settings).
  • Lost items fall on the track: when you get hit, your item drops and the next kart to drive over it uses it.
  • Item Rain: items fall from the sky onto the track, in Grand Prix, VS and Battle. Turn it on with the round Item Rain button on the Single Player page, and set it up in the Item Rain tab of Mod Settings: Frequency, Ground Time, and 4 Rain Modes (Classic, Item Boxes, Mushrooms, Bob-omb Rampage). On a real Wii, it slows the game down: Dolphin is recommended to play with it.
  • Loot Party: every racer hit by an item, or by a kart under a power-up, drops 3 random items in a shower of confetti. Turn it on with its round button under Item Rain.
  • Laps: choose from 1 to 10 laps in VS races (Laps line of the VS rules).
  • Custom Items screen: choose exactly which items can appear. The Items line of the VS rules offers Fever, Vanilla, None or Custom.
  • Very Hard CPUs: in Grand Prix (press + on the engine class page), with their own trophies and records, and in VS races (CPU line of the rules).
  • Battle mode: it includes the Item Fever items that suit an arena; race-only items (like the Banzai Bill or the Black Shell) are left out.
  • Mod Settings in five sections (Gameplay, Menus, Graphics, Sound, Item Rain), also reachable from the pause menu.
  • Its own save file: your Mario Kart Wii save is never modified, and your cup progress starts fresh.
  • HD item icons for Dolphin: an optional folder in the download (see README.txt).

Installation

You need your own copy of Mario Kart Wii, from any region (RMCP01, RMCE01, RMCJ01 or RMCK01). Step-by-step instructions for Wii and Dolphin are in README.txt, inside the download. On Wii, copy the two folders themselves (riivolution and ItemFever) to the root of your SD card, not a folder that contains them, and keep both files of the riivolution folder.

Credits

  • Item Fever is a mod by Kiwinner.
  • Built on Pulsar by MelgMKW, with the item expansion base of mkw-item-expansion by mkwcat (special thanks to SaucyCF), and Kamek by Treeki.
  • Thanks to the Mario Kart Wii modding community and the Custom Mario Kart Wiiki.
The complete credits and the license are in CREDITS.txt, inside the download.

profile._sName: Master Chief on a Ghost (Halo CE) - Funky Kong
profile._sText:
Master Chief from Halo: Combat Evolved, riding a Covenant Ghost in place of Funky Kong's Flame Runner.

The models come straight from the official Halo CE Mod Tools and are fitted onto Funky's own skeleton. Every bone matches the stock rig, so the animations line up and the skin is stable online. Tested in Retro Rewind through Wheel Wizard across many online and offline races with no crashes.

TWO VERSIONS (install only one):

- Wheel Glow: glowing blue/purple energy hoops where the wheels are, so you can still see when your wheels touch the ground (good for timing the respawn-drop boost).

- No Glow: the plain Ghost.

REPLACES:

Funky Kong's default look on the Flame Runner only (la_bike-fk.szs). His other vehicles and the Retro Rewind alt costumes aren't changed.

INSTALL (Wheel Wizard / Retro Rewind):

1. Close Wheel Wizard.

2. Copy ONE of the two "Funky - Master Chief (Halo)" folders into Documents\Wheel Wizard Save\Mods\

3. Open Wheel Wizard and make sure the mod is turned on. If you have another Funky Flame Runner skin, give Master Chief the lower priority number (lower number wins).

4. Pick Funky Kong + Flame Runner.

Other setups (Riivolution / MyStuff, etc.): use the la_bike-fk.szs from the version you want.

NOTES:

- Other players only see the skin if they have it installed too.

- The character select screen still shows normal Funky.

You can check out the WIP version here just in case: https://gamebanana.com/wips/96967

(normal version will always work properly on dolphin emulator) + comes with a patched Wiimmfi main.dol!!

By the way, some tracks have forced crowd noises which I have silenced in the .brsar, so keep that in mind if you plan on using another revo_kart.brsar.

basically, everything is here from the vanilla riivolution pack (which is the definitive version to play) except for the title screen (this kept crashing, so i just used the retro rewind one and replaced the background), the wifi menu (the space background + the mini good egg galaxy model are still there, just the buttons will be the vanilla ones in that menu) and the track names (these remain unchanged as the cup select layout in retro rewind is different. I did not want to confuse anyone by changing the track names to be something completely different) 

the single player menu is also missing some modified buttons (mainly the TT buttons on the first screen you see, these will just use the vanilla buttons instead so it looks a bit off) BUT other than that everything from the riivolution version of the pack is here!! i also recommend changing the UI color to cyan (you can do this in the retro rewind settings which you can find in the single player menu)

one more important thing: USE PATCHES NEEDS TO BE TURNED ON IN WHEEL WIZARD AND DOWNLOAD THE SPECIFIC RETRO REWIND EDITION

If there are any issues or if you have feedback/suggestions you can ping me in my discord server: https://discord.gg/G8ZB8QjnzM (or you can dm me from there)

INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS:
Riivolution edition/Dolphin: Simply extract the .zip and place the contents on your SD card, like you would for any other riivolution mod. For dolphin users you can pick whatever files you want and put it in your own game file or you can load it via riivolution as well!

PC Users (Wheel Wizard): Simply use the one-click-install option under the retro rewind edition!!

Console Users (USE THE RETRO REWIND CHANNEL, NOT RIIVOLUTION): extract the contents of the retro rewind zip, and put everything from the 2nd SMGKARTWIIRR folder (that has a bunch of files inside of it) in RetroRewind6-MyStuff, then move everything from the strm and course folders to outside of the strm and course folders, so the contents are in the MyStuff folder instead. you can delete those folders afterwards

then launch the game via the retro rewind channel (its in the homebrew channel, the channel doesnt have an installer yet as of right now) and make sure mystuff is set to rr!

Known Issues:
-The course introduction music does not play for Coconut Mall for some reason, could be due to overloaded brsar?

-Many UI sounds have a small little tick noise at the end that lasts like 0.1 seconds. It's barely hearable except if youre wearing earbuds but its still worth mentioning. I have tried many ways to fix this but I sadly could not find anything ;( 

P.S.:
To disable the intro demo movie sequence (where mario, peach and luigi are driving on air), use this gecko code:

Disable Title Demo Movie [Diamond]

This will disable the two demo movies that appear when leaving the title screen idle after a short period of time.

NTSC-U

026F59BC 00004800

PAL

026FA924 00004800

Dolphin installation tutorial (English) :

1 - Install the Dolphin emulator.

2 - Install Mario Kart Wii on your PC.

3 - Once the Dolphin emulator is installed and the Mario Kart Wii folder is in your file manager, extract it; once that is done, launch the Dolphin emulator.

4 - On the main Dolphin screen, click "Config," then "Paths," and then "Add."

5 - Click on the Mario Kart Wii folder—do not open it, just click on it—and then click "Select Folder."

6 - If the steps were followed correctly, the game will appear on the main Dolphin screen.

7 - Download Mario Kart Flextime v.1.0.

8 - To launch Mario Kart Flextime: right-click on the Mario Kart Wii game in Dolphin, click "Start Riivolution patches," then "Open XML." Navigate to the "Mario Kart Flextime" folder and then the "riivolution" folder; you will see an XML folder—click on it. The pack will then appear; click on "Disabled" and change both "Disabled" settings to "Enabled." Finally, launch the game and have fun!

Tuto d'installation pour dolphin (Français) : 

1 - Installer l'émulateur Dolphin 

2 - Installer Mario Kart Wii sur votre PC 

3 - Une fois que l'émulateur Dolphin est installer et que le dossier Mario Kart Wii et installer dans votre gestionnaire de fichiers extrayer-le,et une fois terminé lancez Dolphin Emulator

4- Sur la page principal de Dolphin cliquer sur "Configurer", puis "Dossier" et puis "Ajouter" 

5- Cliquer sur le dossier Mario Kart Wii, ne l'ouvrez pas juste cliquer dessus et cliquer sur "Sélectioner ce dossier"

6- Si la manipulation est bien éxécuter le jeu apparaîtra sur la page principale de Dolphin

7- Télécharger Mario Kart Flextime v.1.0

8- ensuite pour lancer Mario Kart Flextime, faites clique droit sur le jeu Mario Kart Wii sur Dolphin, Cliquer sur "Lancer les patchs Riivolution", ensuite sur "Ouvrir un XML", aller dans le dossier "Mario Kart Flextime" puis "riivolution", il y aura un dossier XML, cliquez dessus, vous verrez en suite afficher le pack, cliquez sur "Disabled" et passé les 2 "Disabled" en "Enabled" et pour finir lancer le jeu et amusez vous

This is my official Mario Kart Wii modpack that has been in the works for roughly 6 months, RedYoshiKart's Kart Mayhem! 

This is sort of a sequel to my Mario Party 9 pack, but my MKWii pack has more improvements.

All of the mods were made my me, the only exceptions being some codes that I used to enhance the experience. There is also an optional mode, which is Random Items! (This mode works best on real hardware.)

Characters

Credits:
Allow All Vehicles in Battle Mode Code - Nameless / Scruffy
Draggable Blue Shells Code - MrBean35000vr
Maximum Item Limit Code - Davidevgen
Everyone on The Models Resource, It wouldn't be possible without them.

Known Bugs/Issues
Battle Mode is kinda broken with all of the codes enabled, some objects will be invisible. If you would like to play Battle Mode, I'll have a separate code set for Wii Users that doesn't include the item limit increase (the code that causes the objects to disappear). None of the other modes have this issue. This will not crash your game. 

If you want the vanilla item chances, toggle off Random Items in riivolution on console and rename the RMCE01.gct to RMCE01 (Random Items or whatever you want).gct, and then rename the RMCE01 (Battle Mode Safe).gct to just RMCE01.gct. 

For Dolphin, uncheck the Max Item Modifier code and if not done already, rename the Randomized Common to a different name and change the vanilla back to Common.szs

This pack is best played on Real Hardware due to the codes. If you would like to use Dolphin, I'll have a code list file in the Dolphin Folder.

Online and its related modes are not available. This is due to this being a Riivolution mod and some mods might crash online. All other modes are available.

The codes will only work with NTSC-U Copies of the game. The codes might be available in other regions via searching or using MKW Code Generator.

Please let me know if there are any issues, and I will fix them as quick as I can.

Enjoy the mod! :D

This is the first HUD that I created back in 2022 for "Meap's Texture & Music Pack" and has not received any updates until now. The base version include the following things:
  • Supports all regions, with proper language implementation.
  • Compatible with all of CTGP's mods, including 24-player.
  • Customized speedometer

With this update, it includes the following additions and changes:
  • Added 18 new colors
  • Added a new white outline variant for each color
  • Added 9 lap support for time trials (the lap result screen). Credits to Wingcapman for making this possible.
  • Added support for modpacks running on Pulsar, such as Retro Rewind and Mario Kart Wii Deluxe.
  • Added proper support for Korea region, except for CTGP, Pulsar, and Riivolution. They do not support it :(

Changes
  • Placement textures are properly centered.
  • Removed KM/H texture for vanilla files (too messy to work with).
  • Reverted item textures back to vanilla to avoid ownership issues (those textures were not created by me).
  • Reverted fonts back to vanilla, except for the speedometer numbers (also to avoid ownership issues).

Fixes
  • Fixed the shadow cut-off for the KM/H in CTGP.
  • Fixed incorrect "Time" color texture for the Gold theme.
  • Fixed misspelling placement textures for 21st, 22nd, and 23rd (21st was originally spelled as "21th")

This is version 6, featuring 7 new characters, 7 improved characters, 13 new tracks, 5 fully redesigned menus, new sounds, and exclusive content in the modpack.

  • 13 new tracks added in this version
  • 5 redesigned menus

  • Compatible with CTGP Revolution (24 Players), Mario Kart Wii Deluxe X, and Insane Kart Wii (IKW v2 & IKW v3 with My Stuff)

  • Main Textures: (Boots, Lakitu Sign, Darky Font with a redesigned MKDD counter, New StaticR With White + Yellow Hud, Drift color with Darky Lakitu or Fluttershy)
  • Darky Menu (DKW, MKWII Deluxe X, IKW), Darky Rosalina Menu, Darky Mario Menu, Sonic Generations Menu, CTGP Menu

SUMMARY

The Unrestricted Vehicle Combo mod (UVC for short) is an on-going project made with the community for the community. It's a mod that makes it possible to choose all possible vehicles for any character.
Usually the game restricts characters to only choose their own weight class, but this mod will remove that completely!

UVC is compatible with many other mods, but be aware that it might not work from the get-go. There will be a second download that will contain standalone files which can be used for your own mod, modpack or distribution.

Right from the start, UVC is easy to use for Riivolution-users. It's pretty much like every other mod; you download the .zip, you extract the files, and simply drag and drop everything that's inside the SD Card (root)-folder into the root of your SD Card (which is the very beginning of your SD Card).

INSTALLATION FOR BEGINNERS
1. Download the main zip file (Unrestricted Vehicle Combo (beta 2025-01-22)) and extract the zip.
2a. Console users: Drag and drop all the content that's inside the SD Card (root)-folder onto the root of your SD Card (which is the very beginning of your SD Card).
2b. Dolphin users: Place 's SD Card (root)'s content where your Dolphin's Riivolution folder is. It's not required but you usually keep mods organized.

Wii and WiiU vWii mode
1. Load Riivolution and look for the Unrestricted Vehicle Combo page.
2a. Enable The main feature and enable Load Ocarina .gct file.
2b. To make Mii Outfit C playable, enable The main feature and select Enable with Mii Outfit C from Load Ocarina .gct file.
3. Before launching the game, make sure that every other mod that are on other pages (if available) are turned off! While this mod is made to be able to combine with other mods, you need to tinker with the menu files in order to make this work (as plenty of mods and modpacks use customized menus).

Dolphin
1a. For regular users who want to just play the Unrestricted Vehicle Combo mod with any other mods or cheats enabled, please go to Config and uncheck Enable Cheats.
1b. For advanced users who want to combine mods with different cheats, make sure to download the Standalone Files .zip and get the Gecko codes, and add them to your Dolphin's Gecko codes list.

2. Once you've played the content from the SD Card (root)-folder in the right folder, right-click on the game, click on Start with Riivolution Patches..., then click on Open Riivolution XML... in the bottom-left corner and find the directory where the Unrestricted Vehicle Combo mod's Riivolution XML is (which is in a riivolution-folder).
3a. For regular users, enable The main feature and enable Load Ocarina .gct file (for making Mii Outfit C playable, select Enable with Mii Outfit C instead).
3b. For advanced users, only enable The main feature.

Users are able to get all the files from the main download .zip and put them in their extracted filesystem, and use the Gecko codes and custom menu files that are provided in the Standalone Files .zip. This way you can rebuild the game without the need of using Riivolution!

CURRENT ISSUES

This mod still has a few issues to address, such as the Korean version crashes when trying to load the 4-player mode menu.

There are some weird glitches going on with battle mode when playing single player or 2-player mode where the CPU players try to load non-Standard team-color vehicles which do not exist in the game, therefore a temporary fix is made to make them load VS Race vehicle models instead. Is it meant to play with just all the Standard vehicles, though.
And before you ask... Yes, it is possible to use a Gecko code or script to force the players to run VS Race vehicles in battle mode too, if you much prefer that!

Remember that this mod is still in an early state, so expect some changes. The character animations and vehicle models are unchanged, so model-clipping might occur. And since we've been working with over 5000 files, except some mistakes such as loading the wrong textures or even models. more info about this is listed in the download.
All this will be changed and fixed in later updates!

CAUTION!!
Make sure to remove any Unrestricted Vehicle Combo mod from your SD card to make absolutely sure you do a clean install. This mod is in an experimental state and every update might not fully replace everything. Starting Beta Revision 3, the folder structure for its content is changed.

Make sure to read the readme if the mod doesn't want to work. It has been reported several times by other people getting stuck with [ ? ] buttons and crashes on the menu, while it really is just a plug 'n play kind of mod. And please, make sure to playtest without any other mod first before actually playing, you want to make sure it works.

And since this is not your average Mario Kart Wii mod, this might not work with the Wheel Wizard function!

UPDATE HISTORY

2025-01-22 Beta Revision 3
  • Added an option to make Mii Outfit C playable. (If you have any other Mii Outfit C-related mod enabled, then please disable that one as it will cause conflicts with each other!! And for the sake of players misusing this, its standalone code is NOT INCLUDED! This will get updated eventually, don't worry.)
  • Fixed Koopa Troopa's race vehicle models.
  • Fixed Wario's race vehicle models.
  • Added Bits's "Donkey Kong menu model texture fix": https://wiki.tockdom.com/wiki/The_greatest_mod_ever_made_(Donkey_Kong_Edit)
  • Fixed Medium Mii Outfit C's lightweight vehicles (loaded the medium weight vehicle models instead).
  • Fixed Mii Outfit C's Magikruiser menu model's tires.
  • Reverted KartParam.bin back to its original format because it loaded a modified version with Inside-Drift Blue Falcon instead (whoops!).
  • Moved the credits inside the folder structure so that it doesn't goof around on the root of the SD Card.

2024-12-02 Released a beta on Gamebanana

profile._sText:
Warning: This mod contains slightly adult themes and mild language!

Inspired by past Google Translate mods comes Pomeranian Fun, A retranslation of Mario Party 8! 

This mod takes (almost) every single instance of text in the game and runs it through Google translate.

- Version 0.0
As of now, Most of the base text is translated. As for the graphics, everything in Party mode is changed. Not so sure about the side modes, however. 

This has not been tested on the PAL version of MP8, so I am unsure if it works. 

- Text not changed
Practice mode is currently unchanged, simply because I forgot it existed :P

Board intros and Animated Graphics: Much of the texts graphics in Party Mode are created with data saving in mind. This means letters in a word are shared if they repeat in the same word. For example: In "DK's Treetop Temple" the letters T,e, and p are repeating throughout the text. So the graphic would look something like "DK's Tretopml". Trying to change these graphics is extremely difficult as the game predetermines what order this text is displayed. Therefore, I have removed the board intros all together as to not "ruin" the immersion.

Moments I've Missed: There are many textures in Mario Party 8, and it's difficult to sort through them all, so there is a chance I may have missed a few things.

Download Options:
There are two ways to play this mod: Dolphin, and Riivolution 

- Dolphin: This version contains everything. If you wish to play with as much translated text as possible, this is the version for you! Be sure to check the Readme for instructions on how to install.

- Riivolution: This version contains only the textboxes. Unfortunately, I could not find a way to compress the graphics into the gamefiles. I hope to find a way to include graphics some day, but for now it seems to be impossible (at least to a beginner modder like me) .

This is my first mod, so I hope you enjoy it!

Did ya miss me? No? It doesn't matter! 

Today I present to you: Sunset Falls 2!!! work in progress :(


Around 6 months ago, I released Sunset Falls V1. 


And I'm not gonna lie, I wasn't particularly happy with it. Which is why I've decided to come back to it and work on another version. Sadly, working with dolphin textures and dumping them isn't exactly the most fun thing in the world. So here's a W.I.P build of version 2! Which will hopefully be done sometime soon.

What exactly is "Sunset Falls" though?

Pretty much, it's a cosmetic texture pack that changes the way Mario Party 8 looks. Specifically, to make all the blue skies in the game an orange sky. To give off the impression that it's Sunset! 

It also alters a lot of the colours in the minigames! Why? Well why not!

*This pack was created using the GC controller mod for Mario Party 8, therefore the minigames that are usually replaced in that mod aren't supported for the moment.*

This mod aims to give off a new experience and perspective, but it is only the WIP Build of the 2nd version. There may or may not be some noticeable bugs. But all feedback is welcome.

profile._sText:
A mod that replaces Toad in Mario Party 9 with Toadette!

Features:
  • Toadette's model over the playable Toad, without replacing the Toad hosts.
  • Pre-rendered sprites for almost all of the UI in the game, including menus, minigame icons and a few extra things.
  • Name changed in the dialogue.
Voices not included since I don't know how to do them and I think Toad shares voice clips with the hosts anyways.

Issues:
  • The icons for the minigames "Spike Strike" and "Bowser's Block Battle" couldn't be changed through normal means as editing their files crashes the game. I have provided textures to use with Dolphin's custom texture function and instructions for how to use them, but this does mean that those icons are exclusive to Dolphin and not console.

Special Thanks:
  • yosh_y who playtested the mod and helped fix the issues with the game freezing.

NOTE: This mod ONLY works for the US version of the game and only supports English, it won't work on any other language or version.

That's all, hope you enjoy!

Also I promise I won't only make Toadette mods in the future lol

Here another mods that I have made for Mario Sports Mix from the Wii and the first Star Fox characters mods for this game as it seem this game love crossover between Mario and Final Fantasy so why not with more franchise outside Mario and Final Fantasy?

Today it's Falco Lombardi from the Star Fox serie but with his design from Super Smash Bros Ultimate based on Star Fox Zero who replace Mario.

I know the mods isn't perfect but it the best that I can do for now as Brawlbox/BrawlCrate are a pain in the a*s for working with it when I want replace characters model. Because, like I say for my previous mods, Brawlbox/BrawlCrate is very sensitive about weight paint so, if a weight paint enter in contact on a part of a model who have already a weight paint assigned or if you have miss a tiny part of the model for weight paint and that it don't have any weight paint on it, it can cause Brawlbox/BrawlCrate to crash.

Anyway I planned to add Fox, Slippy, ROB, Wolf, Leon, Peppy and Krystal but it will take some times until I go on them.

Finally, even if Falco replace all Mario model in game, there is just the Mario model from the menu/tournament that I didn't replace because, unlike the others files, the Menu/Tournament files have all characters from this game together in the same files instead be separated in their own files.

INSTALLATION 

For install this mods, you must extract your own Mario Sports Mix game on PC and go into DATA\files\chr and then you replace the original files by my mods inside the zip files. I don't know if this mods work on a real Wii but I know it work on emulator so playing this mods on emulator is adviced.

Also a big thanks to:

-thezebradude1 for have extract Falco Lombardi from Super Smash Bros Ultimate and edit him.

-Vad for help me with somes good advices for the Mario Sports Mix modding.

And, before I forget, feel free to do anything you want with this mods like port, fix, reskin or whatever you want but don't forget to credit all the people who are involved with this mods.

Enjoy!

A MEGA upgrade to Mario Sports Mix!

Introducing the demo of Mario Sports Megamix, the largest ever modpack for Mario Sports Mix:
  • All characters have four costumes to choose from
  • Multiple players can choose to play as the same character
  • New outfielders in Dodgeball and different Shy Guys in Hockey
  • Reworked stage hazards and appearances
  • More expressive expressions for Mario characters
  • Pokémon Stadium replaces Mario Stadium
  • New sound effects and game music

+ MORE!


Mario Sports Megamix supports both NTSC-U and PAL releases of the game in all languages, on Riivolution or USB Loaders through ISO patching. Both of the methods also work for Dolphin. It is also possible to play online by patching the game with Wiimmfi or using Dolphin netplay. For technical support/help, join the MSM Community discord server.

Mario Sports Megamix uses its own save file instead of your current save file. This is because future updates will possibly break save files when they are used with the original game. As such, when you start the game, it is recommended to use the following cheat code to unlock everything: 

- Hover over a save file on the startup screen. You must hover over it the entire time while doing this code. 
- Enter the code (a nunchuck is required):
  1.  Hold C and press 1 three times, then release C.
  2.  Hold Z then press 1 four times, then release Z.
  3.  Hold C and Z together then press 1 five times, then release.
If the code was successfully entered, four gems should appear on the save file and the main menu background in the sports select will match what is shown in the screenshots.

Installation (Riivolution)

  1. Follow this guide to homebrew your Wii if it is not already modded and download Riivolution from here if you do not have it. 
  2. Move the riivolution folder inside the apps folder on your SD card.
  3.  Download the correct installation for your region. 
  4.  Extract the downloaded zip to the root of your SD card.
  5.  When in Riivolution, make sure to select megamix.xml and ensure that "File Patching" is set to Enabled.
The Riivolution build also has support to load files from /megamix/My Stuff. The "My Stuff" folder is not included and will have to be provided by mods or you will have to create it yourself.

Installation (ISO/WBFS Builder)

  1.  Install Wiimm's Toolset if you haven't already. If it is your first time installing, restart your computer after installation.
  2. Create a new folder to work in. Open the command prompt in this location.
  3.  Place the ISO of the game in the folder you created earlier.
  4. In the command prompt, type wit extract game.iso megamix where game.iso is the name or your iso. You can also type game.wbfs if you are using a wbfs file.
  5. Download the correct version of the mod for your region and extract it.  
  6.  Copy the recently extracted megamix folder into the folder you created earlier. You should get a prompt to replace files—say yes.
  7.  In the command prompt, type wit copy megamix game.wbfs --name "Mario Sports Megamix" --id "MEGA00" where game.wbfs is the name of your output file. It can be either .iso or .wbfs. It doesn't matter what filetype you originally started with. IF you are making a PAL iso, type "MEGA01" instead of "MEGA00". It will not impede functionality, but we are keeping things consistent. The new id will also have you create a new save file.
  8.  If you run into any issues, disable cheats in your USB Loader.

Troubleshooting on Dolphin

Since the main.dol file is patched, there have been reports of inconsistent issues with the mod on Dolphin. 
  1. The first troubleshooting step is to disable cheats, which may fix the issue.
  2. If that did not fix it, reenable cheats. If you did the Riivolution method, delete the custom main.dol. If you did the ISO Patcher method, repatch but use the original main.dol instead of the new one.
  3.  Then right click on the game, click properties, click on Game Config, then go to the editor tab. At the very bottom there is "User Config". Paste in the correct User Config for your region. This will remove existing gecko codes you have, so back those up if you want them later.

Stage Changes
  • Pokemon Stadium — new stage that replaces Mario Stadium. Different balls are used on this stage that resemble pokeballs and new music plays.
  • Koopa Troopa Beach — different items wash up depending on your Q Panel setting. On "none" and "few", only green shells wash up. On "normal", red shells also wash up. On "many", green shells, red shells, bananas, bombs, and mini mushrooms can all wash up. In dodgeball mode, Bowser Jr. replaces Yoshi as the outfielder.
  • Peach's Castle — in dodgeball mode, Toad replaces Yoshi as the outfielder.
  • Toad Park — in dodgeball mode, Toad replaces Yoshi as the outfielder.
  • DK Dock — updated texture in Dodgeball mode. The dodgeballs outfielders are replaced with Blue DK and Red DK.
  • Luigi's Mansion — no changes.
  • Daisy Garden — in dodgeball mode, Cactuar replaces Yoshi as the outfielders.
  • Wario Factory — in hockey mode, Snifit replaces Shy Guy as the goalies.
  • Bowser Jr. Boulevard — in hockey mode, Snifit replaces Shy Guy as the goalies.
  • Bowser's Castle — in dodgeball mode, Bowser replaces Yoshi as the outfielders. In hockey mode, Snifit replaces Shy Guy as the goalies.
  • Waluigi Pinball — no changes.
  • Ghoulish Galleon — in dodgeball mode, one teammate will permanently stay in the box. There are no outfielders.
  • Star Airship — in exhibition, the background now changes just like in the Tournament version. 20 coins can be collected instead of 10.
  • Western Junction — the Shy Guys on the train throw different items depending on your Q Panel settings. On "none", "few", and "normal", they throw bananas. On "many", they throw green shells, red shells, bombs, bananas, and mini mushrooms.

In addition, the BRSAR is also automatically patched with a gecko code. This means brstm files can directly be replaced for custom music with cutting out. A code was also created to prevent characters from 'disappearing' as is common with custom characters in Mario Sports Mix.

For more help with the mod and more information on what will be added in future updates, please join the MSM Community discord server. Mario Sports Megamix is distributed with a CC-BY license. You are free to do whatever you want with it so long as you give credit. As an additional note, the download might say WARNING and that there are executable files. The ".bin" files that are flagged are just compressed models and/or other files from the game.

profile._sText:
Super Mario RPG is definitely the first RPG I played on my Nintendo Switch. It was perfect!

Many fans and critics wanted Geno in Mario Sports Mix, since the game is a cross between Nintendo and Square Enix. But! They were bummed by his absence without a trace, not even as a cameo nor is mentioned. This caused a fan outrage with some questioning the decision and many being confused on why Geno was excluded, especially considering that some other Square Enix characters are playable.

Fortunately, just because the iconic star-doll had limited appearances for copyright issues doesn't mean that he's absent in-game. And I wanted to cheer his fans up a little, so here he is, ready to get this show on the road!

Features:
  • Geno over the normal/red ninja, since they both share the same energy
  • Icons for sports and character select
  • Name in the character select screen and during sports
  • A custom set of voice clips, provided by none other than the talented Zeno Robinson, ever since Chris Niosi's livestream titled "charity of the seven stars"
  • A version with all of Acht05's mods combined with my own, meaning Geno plus Rosalina, Pauline, Birdo, Toadsworth and Toadette
  • Compatibility for all languages in both versions of the game

Much like the Hammer Bros., Geno is given a human-like voice, as opposed to his SFX in Super Mario RPG. If you're wondering why I made a custom set of voice clips for him, it's because I think there's not enough voice acting in the Switch remake of the classic RPG (aside from Bowser and Yoshi). BTW, I just filtered his voice with a bit of delay through Vegas Pro 21.0.

Known issues:
  • Geno's special attack is still the same as the ninja. But I feel like he could perform a Geno Whirl instead of a Leaf Veil. It was my mistake.
  • It seems that the shadow white ninja accidentally shares the same voice as Geno, but that's okay.

Credits:
  • yosh_y who helped me fixing an issue with the Geno model.
  • Saulf who helped me edit the red ninja's files and voice clips, as well as making all of the Gecko codes.
  • TheN00b21 who made the tutorials for this game.
  • Acht05 for mods that add Rosalina, Pauline, Birdo, Toadsworth and Toadette.
  • ArtePiazza for Geno's icons in sports and character select. I just edited them through GIMP 2.10.38 to make him accurate to the original Mario RPG.

IMPORTANT: In order for the mod to have all of its features (the names and special effects), you HAVE to use gecko codes included in the README, so make sure to check it out before installing.

That's all, hope you enjoy!

profile._sText:
Mario World Series is a large fan expansion of Mario Super Sluggers (USA). You can run it on Riivolution on a Wii or in Dolphin.

What's in it

  • 250 playable characters. All 62 from the base game plus 188 new ones.
  • 24 captain teams, including new star swings and star pitches.
  • 12 new stadiums, each with its own original music.
  • 47 new missions including hitting, fielding, and games.
  • 18 new items including the Boomerang Flower, Blooper, Spiny Shell, Red Shell and Bullet Bill.
  • Two new CPU levels (5 and 6). The CPU uses precision hitting, items, and abilities.
  • New abilities, including Clamber Jump, Turnip Pluck, and many others.

Install

Wii

  1. Copy the riivolution and MarioWorldSeries folders to the root of your SD card.
  2. Start Riivolution from the Homebrew Channel with the Mario Super Sluggers disc in the drive.
  3. Set Mario World Series to Enabled and press Launch.
Dolphin

  1. Copy the riivolution and MarioWorldSeries folders into Dolphin's Load/Riivolution folder (File > Open User Folder, then Load/Riivolution. Create the folder if it is not there).
  2. Right-click Mario Super Sluggers in the game list and pick Start with Riivolution Patches.
  3. Set Mario World Series to Enabled and press Start.


Mario World Series is a free fan mod. It is not made, endorsed or sold by Nintendo.

profile._sText:
This mod turns New Super Mario Bros. Wii, into a multiplayer manhunt for 2 to 4 players, inspired by u know what

Everything starts in the lobby, one player is the Speedrunner, while everyone else is a Hunter

The Speedrunner must beat the game with only one life, the Hunters must stop them, and they have unlimited lives

If the Speedrunner loses their only life, the Hunters win immediately

Also, Ground Pounds do damage

THE LOBBY

Starting a new game takes everyone straight into the lobby

The Speedrunner is whoever has the ring of stars around them, the same ring from the Toad House, Mario has it by default

The box in the bottom-right corner always shows who the current Speedrunner is

Want to be the Speedrunner? Ground Pound whoever has the ring

When everyone is ready, touch the flagpole and the manhunt begins

THE SPEEDRUNNER

The Speedrunner's goal is simple to reach the end without dying

They only have 1 life for the whole run, lives can't be gained in any way

Levels play one after another with no world map in between, so there's no time to rest, secret exits still work

THE HUNTERS

The Hunters' goal is to make the Speedrunner lose their only life

By default the Hunters have infinite lives, dying only slows them down

GAME MODES

The game mode is chosen in the Riivolution menu before starting the game

Normal

The manhunt starts at 1-1 and the Speedrunner has to beat the entire game

Random World

The manhunt starts at the first level of a random world

Instead of beating the entire game, the Speedrunner only has to beat that world's castle

SPECIAL MECHANICS

These things are always active while playing the mod:

  • No time limit

  • Ground Pounds hurt other players (except in the lobby, where they steal the ring)

  • No bubble button: players can't put themselves in a bubble to escape

  • Bubbles pop by themselves after 10 seconds

  • No bubble shaking

INSTALLATION

Game Version

This mod works with every version of New Super Mario Bros. Wii (or at least it should)

Installation on Dolphin

profile._sText:
NEW SUPER MARIO BROS. WII IMPOSTOR MOD

This mod completely changes how the game works to create a multiplayer-only experience for 3 to 4 players, inspired by social deduction games like Among Us.

Everything is clearly explained in-game in the HOW TO PLAY level, but here's a more detailed overview of what to expect.

At the start of each level, one player is randomly chosen as the Impostor, while everyone else becomes an Innocent.

The Impostor must secretly eliminate the Innocents without revealing their identity. To do so, they can use exclusive special attacks with different effects and cooldowns, but also everything New Super Mario Bros. Wii already gives players to mess with each other: throwing shells, pushing players with Ground Pounds, grabbing and throwing them into hazards, sabotaging their jumps, using enemies and level hazards against them ...

But the Innocents aren't defenseless either.

They must survive, collect coins, cooperate and figure out who the Impostor is. Every 100 coins gives the Innocents an extra life, while the Impostor cannot regain lives through coins.

Innocents can also fight back. If you think another player is acting suspiciously, you can try to kill them using the game's regular mechanics. If you manage to completely eliminate the Impostor by taking away all of their lives, the Innocents win immediately.

Of course, attacking the wrong person might just be doing the Impostor's job for them...

THE IMPOSTOR

The Impostor has access to three special attacks, assigned to MINUS, A, and PLUS.
These attacks either target every player or one randomly selected player. They never reveal who triggered them, making it impossible to know for sure who the Impostor IS just from an attack.

Different Impostor types have completely different abilities, ranging from stunning players to summoning dangerous obstacles or directly hunting down a target.

The stronger the attack, the longer its cooldown. All three abilities share a global cooldown, so choosing when and how to attack matters.

Impostor attacks can also be dangerous to the Impostor themselves, so they aren't always a free kill.

And because everyone can already kill each other using normal Mario mechanics, not every suspicious death necessarily reveals who the Impostor is.

THE INNOCENTS

The Innocents' main goal is to stay alive and identify the Impostor.

Collecting coins is especially important: reaching 100 coins restores one life to the Innocents, while the Impostor receives nothing.

Player lives are completely hidden, meaning you never know exactly how close another player is to being eliminated.
The only way to keep track is to watch carefully and remember who has lost lives ... which is far from easy in the middle of all the chaos.

You can cooperate with players you trust, stay away from suspicious players... or take matters into your own hands and try to eliminate someone you believe is the Impostor.

Just remember: friendly fire is very real.

THE DEATH GOAL

Reaching the end of the level isn't enough for the Impostor.

Before a vote can happen, enough lives must have been lost during the level to reach the configurable Impostor Death Goal.

If the players reach the end without meeting this objective, the Impostor loses and no vote takes place.

This forces the Impostor to actually take risks and participate instead of simply hiding until the end of the level.

Both the Death Goal and the players' starting lives can be customized in the SETTINGS level.

THE VOTE

If the Death Goal has been reached and enough Innocents survive until the end of the level, a vote begins.

The remaining players must decide who they believe the Impostor is.

Vote out the Impostor -> Innocents win.

Vote out an Innocent -> Impostor wins.

But the vote isn't the only way to win. The Impostor can eliminate enough Innocents during the level and win before anyone even reaches the end.

POINTS

Winning a game awards 1 Point, as long as you're still in the game when the round ends.

If the Impostor manages to win before the vote by eliminating enough players, they earn 2 Points instead.

Eliminated players receive no points.

Scores are displayed on the main map and reset when changing maps.

DESIGNED AROUND MARIO'S CHAOS

The mod is built around New Super Mario Bros. Wii's existing multiplayer interactions.

You can still grab and throw players, bounce on their heads, push them around, throw shells, use enemies against them or simply trick someone into falling to their death.

The difference is that now, one of you actually wants that to happen.

Every accident can be suspicious.

Every attack can be intentional.

And sometimes, killing the person you think is the Impostor is the fastest way to find out if you were right.

----------------------------------------------------------------------

INSTALLATION

Game Version

This mod requires:
New Super Mario Bros. Wii PAL / Europe Rev 2

Installation: Dolphin

This mod has currently only been tested using Riivolution on Dolphin.

  1. Install the mod as a Riivolution Patch and launch it through Dolphin.
  2. For each player, configure an Emulated Wii Remote.
  3. Set the Wii Remote extension to None.
  4. Enable Sideways Wii Remote.
  5. Make sure Rumble is enabled and correctly configured.
    This is important: the Impostor is secretly revealed through their controller's vibration!
  6.  You can play locally ... or ONLINE using Dolphin's NetPlay!

Important

Do not use a Nunchuk.
The mod is designed to be played with a Wii Remote held sideways, with no extension.

You do not need to configure motion controls or Shake in Dolphin.

The B button simulates a Wii Remote shake, making actions such as picking up players and performing mid-air spins easier to use with a regular controller.

The Impostor uses three special buttons:
MINUS -> Small Attack
A -> Medium Attack
PLUS -> Powerful Attack

These buttons normally have other functions in NSMBW, but the mod repurposes them for the Impostor's special attacks.

The File Select menu has been replaced with an Impostor Movepool Selection menu, allowing you to change the Impostor's attacks before starting the game.

A minimum of 3 players is required

profile._sName: Goombas over Toads for New & Newer SMBW
profile._sText:
This mod replaces both Toads with Goombas (a normal one and a Gloomba).

Features:
  • Goombas over Toads, with all models changed including the different powerups and cutscene models.
  • UI Icons, as well as textures for the motion controlled objects, checkpoint flag, etc.
  • Gold Goomba replacing the Toad you save in levels, instead of Pink Gold Peach. Minigame house Toads and chest Toads remain the same.
  • Patches for both the vanilla game and Newer Super Mario Bros. Wii. These should be compatible with other mods in theory.
  • Player 1 can change character code included, so no need to use any external cheats to play as them in single player.

Known Issues:
  • No custom voices.
  • Their eyes flicker a bit in the overworld. I tried to make this as unnoticeable as possible but it still happens.
  • Their feet don't always connect with the body, though it shouldn't be too noticeable.
  • Hitboxes aren't changed, so it can be a bit challenging to tell when something will hit you or not. Also, objects and players float when picked up by a Goomba.
  • The propeller on the hat of the propeller suit is a bit misaligned due to their heads being lower than the Toads.
NOTE: I have only tested the patches on Dolphin, no idea if they work on a real Wii.

Credits:
  • MikeSelcouth, who provided the emblems through his Mario emblem repository. Check that out here!
  • mkwcat, who made the Player 1 can change character code.

That should be all, hope you enjoy!

An add-on mod for mkwcat's nsmbw-project (aka the 8 Player Mod) that adds Toadsworth as a playable character and makes some tweaks to Toadette's textures and model.

Features and Changes:

  • Playable Toadsworth replacing the black spotted Toad.

  • Centered Toadette's head model (it was a bit off centered before).
  • Changed Toadette's icons for the motion controlled objects, Koopa Clown Car, etc. to be consistent with her emblem. Colors have also been slightly changed for the motion controlled objects to be closer to her pink color.

Credits:

  • mkwcat, who not only made the original 8 Player mod, but also gave me permission to post this add-on mod.
  • MikeSelcouth, who made the Toadsworth emblem I used for his checkpoint flag and motion controlled objects. Check out his repository for Mario emblems where I got it from!

That should be all, hope you enjoy!

profile._sName: Toad & Toadette for New & Newer SMBW
profile._sText:
This mod is an edit of StupidMarioBros1Fan's Toad & Toadette mod that changes a few things to "modernize" it. When the original mod was made, NSMBU Deluxe hadn't been made yet and thus there was no basis for Toadette's outfits, so StupidMarioBros1Fan came up with his own instead. While he did a great job, the outfits in the mod now look different than what they're supposed to, so this is my attempt to change that and make some small improvements along the way.

Features and Changes:

  • Toadette's powerup outfits have been changed to look like they do in New Super Mario Bros. U Deluxe. This includes both model and texture edits. Her normal clothes were also tweaked a little bit.
  • Toadette's braids have been resized and changed to resemble how they looked in said game.
  • Improved the rigging on the dress.
  • Toad's Penguin Suit has been changed to look like it does in the Mario Galaxy movie.
  • Minigame house Toads have been changed to Green Toads, as well as the one in Peach's castle and the ones you save from enemy chests. A few icons relating to these were also changed for consistency.
  • Patches for both the vanilla game and Newer Super Mario Bros. Wii. These should be compatible with other mods in theory.
  • All new textures for both Toad and Toadette's hammer suits in Newer. The mod uses the Improved Hammer suits as a base, so files for Mario and Luigi's models are included too (which were made by StupidMarioBros1Fan too).
  • New icons for the characters in both games (the ones for Vanilla are taken from mkwcat's 8 player mod).
  • Changed the emblems for both of them to their modern ones, instead of using Blue and Yellow Toad's with different colors.
  • Player 1 can change character code included, so no need to use any external cheats to play as them in single player.

Known Issues:
  • No custom voices as I don't know how to do that.
NOTE: I have only tested the patches on Dolphin, no idea if they work on a real Wii.

Credits:

  • StupidMarioBros1Fan, who created the original mod this is based on. Go check out the original here and make sure to check his channel out too!
  • mkwcat, who made the 8 player mod where I got some of the icons for Toadette from and for making the Player 1 can change character code.
  • MikeSelcouth, who provided the emblems through his Mario emblem repository. Check that out here!

That should be all, hope you enjoy!

profile._sText:
So it's pretty funny, I was messing around in Capers Across Dimensions and found a reference to the Mario Runs For His Life meme, in the video description there's a drive link to the mod used, I could find no other references to on the internet (nor could Brave AI) except for the QA here about Deluxe NSMBWii not working.

Given how many external drive links are prone to failure or removal, I'm redistributing it here. The file size is impressively small, mainly because it just reconfigures levels.

Looking around in it with cheats, this mod seems to be a full game romhack. Levels seem to be mediumly longer and slightly harder compared to NSMBWii. By the title screen copyright, it was made in 2013 by "M&SG"; the one GB profile the credit section found doesn't seem to be it.

If the creator(s) would like me to remove this, or private it, I'll do that. This is more to make sure it's not lost once the drive link goes down.

-----

The two downloads are for the redistribute left as-is (for some reason named W91), and a renamed one for clarity which also has the cheated save file (which completed the game, meaning you can save whenever).

-----

And no I didn't find the Mario Runs For His Life level, it wasn't the final star world level.

-----

Also there's a decompilation in progress, if interested in contributing.

Decomp.dev has been shut down, I recommend continuing development with AI, make Discord servers or other decentralized social organizations for your own projects.

I recommend looking into ByteMatch.dev, Decomp.net, and OpenPortsGames for additional ideas, resources, and social organization.

profile._sName: New Super Mario Bros. Wii: Grand Star Mode
profile._sText:
GRAND STAR MODE
Grand Star Mode is a brand-new Hard Mode Mod that aims to take the original game's levels, and make them harder by introducing new mechanics and gimmicks to make the stage feel new, and harder than the original game, but not too hard.

BEGINNER FRIENDLY
Unlike other Hard Mode Mods, this one is one the relatively easy side. While it's definetly harder than the original game, it doesn't quite reach the same level of insanity as Harder Super Mario Bros. Wii or Superstar Mode. It's meant to be something of a stepping-stone to those other, harder mods, to test your skill while not trying to frusterate you (Too much). So no Shell Jumps, no One-Sided Wall Jumps, no insane Kaizo Tech. Just normal platforming. It's the kind of mod where if you think you might be able to beat it, you probably can.

THREE WORLDS
This mod is only the game's first three worlds. More may come out in the future, but don't get your hopes up. Think of it like a Demo, but I'm being fully transparent that there's a good chance the full thing never releases. So, this may just be the first part of something bigger, or it may be the entire mod. Only time will tell.
5-1 is technically complete, but it's graphics are unfinished.

WARNING; I do not own a Modded Wii, so I have no idea whether or not this mod works on actual hardware. I know it for sure works on Dolphin Emulator, so play that if you can, but it may just not function on a real Wii.

profile._sName: Newer Super Mario Land 2 Golden Starcoins DEMO!
profile._sText:
A reimagining of the classic Gameboy Game: Super Mario Land 2 in the Newer wii engine!


Story:

Temper tantrum tyrant seizes Mario Land!

In his greatest Game Boy adventure, Mario faces off against his evil rival Wario, who has captured Mario Land and turned it into his private playground.

To toss Wario off his ill-gotten throne, Mario must search all-new worlds for the six golden coins that unlock the gate to Mario's castle. A mob of monsters, old and new, seek to stop him. Along the way, through 6 zones, Mario can nab Power Mushrooms, Super Stars and Fire Flowers for extra power. And if he eats the Propeller Mushroom, he'll turn into a high-flying man.

NEWER Super Mario Land 2 and the Golden Starcoins is ONLY for Nintendo Wii. 
Up to 4 players can play at the same time!

How to install the game:

When you have Newer super mario bros wii (iso or wbfs) in dolphin in a path you will be good to go: (i.e. you will see it appear in your list of games) 
(If not look on yt how to make a Newer super mario bros wii iso or wbfs and come back here after)

First press the right mouse button on Newer wii  -> open Properties -> in the top right press the arrow button to the right until you see "Filesystem" -> Press Filesystem -> press the right mouse button on your disk ->  extract entire disk -> (do is somewhere ez to find.) Let that do its thing for a min -> open the map in your file Explorer

Open a new tab in file explorer (downloads most likely) and extract the Newer Super Mario Land 2 and the Golden Starcoins Demo file with 7zip or winrar -> open the file and you shoud see "DATA" -> drag the "DATA" folder to your extracted Newer wii and put it on the "DATA" folder there.  Press replace all when that window shows up. ->  make a new path in dolphin to this patched Newer wii. 

->  (you shoud see it as main.dol in dolphin as the file name) (If you dont see filenames go to the top and press the right mouse button on "Title" a popup menu will show up.  now Checkmark "File Name" and now you will see the filenames)  press the right mouse button on the new Newer wii (main.dol) (0,00 B) and do convert file -> press covert and name it something like Newer Super Mario Land 2 and the Golden Starcoins Demo and put it in your game folder (or somewhere where you put your games) and hit save/ok

 now you can delete the extracted files (NOT the iso that you just created)(everyting but that) and bingo you can play the mod! (you shoud see a new Newer wii with the name you just created. you can check this by pressing the right mouse button on Newer wii  -> open Properties. if the name of the window is the same as the one you created than that will be Newer mario land 2 mod)

How to install the Texture pack:
look it up on YT
Have fun! Lmk if there is anything wrong with te mod. (its my first mod for this game.) If you have Feedback for me that would be nice! Also dont forget to like if you want to see more!

profile._sText:
Titel: New Super Mario Bros Wii Rewritten (In Entwicklung)

Offizielle Website Von Uns Mit Allen Mod Updates: https://secret-bros.jimdosite.com

Beschreibung: Erlebe das klassische Abenteuer von Mario und seinen Freunden in einer völlig neuen Form mit "New Super Mario Bros Wii Rewritten"! Diese aufregende Modifikation des beliebten Nintendo-Spiels bietet eine Frischzellenkur für das Gameplay, während sie gleichzeitig die vertrauten Level und Charaktere erhält, die die Spieler kennen und lieben.

In "New Super Mario Bros Wii Rewritten" werden alle Level von Grund auf neu gestaltet, um eine aufregende Spielerfahrung zu bieten, die selbst die erfahrensten Mario-Veteranen herausfordern wird. Von neuen Hindernissen über veränderte Gegnerplatzierungen bis hin zu innovativen Rätseln bietet diese Mod eine Fülle von neuen Herausforderungen, die es zu meistern gilt.

Trotz der Neugestaltung der Level werden die Original-Assets der Level beibehalten, um die Nostalgie und den Charme des ursprünglichen Spiels zu bewahren. Spieler werden sich in vertrauter Umgebung wiederfinden, während sie gleichzeitig von den frischen Designelementen und Überraschungen begeistert sein werden, die in jedem Level auf sie warten.

Die Demo der Mod wird am 1.04.2024 veröffentlicht und präsentiert die Spieler mit der ersten Welt, die vollgepackt ist mit neuen Herausforderungen und Abenteuern. Die Vollversion von "New Super Mario Bros Wii Rewritten" wird voraussichtlich zwischen 2024 und 2025 veröffentlicht, und verspricht eine epische Reise durch überarbeitete Level, die den Spielspaß von Mario auf eine ganz neue Ebene heben!

Diese Mod befindet sich derzeit in Entwicklung und wird seit November 2023 in liebevoller Handarbeit von nur zwei enthusiastischen Entwicklern, MaxiTheDaxi und pierreso, gestaltet. Es ist ihr erstes Mod-Projekt, aber sicher nicht ihr letztes! Weitere Mods sind geplant, und die Spieler können sich auf Screenshots und bald einen Trailer auf YouTube freuen, der einen ersten Blick auf das überarbeitete Abenteuer von Mario und seinen Freunden bietet.

Tauche ein in die Welt von "New Super Mario Bros Wii Rewritten" und erlebe Mario, Luigi, Peach und Toad wie nie zuvor in diesem aufregenden Remix des klassischen Nintendo-Abenteuers!

Erster Trailer: https://youtu.be/nDJW8p50sR4

Meine Pläne: https://www.bullsheet.de/S/Secret-Bros_Plaene_t5YcnmPHgYxX

profile._sName: XBOX, Switch & PlayStation UI for NSMBWii
profile._sText:
New Super Mario Bros. Wii is my favourite game of the NSMB Series, but when I started replaying it on Emulator because I lost my disc, I found that the controls were a bit confusing and when I started Image Editing this idea came to my mind, "What if I made the game less confusing for everyone ?" and so here we are... A full Texture Pack which replaces most of the buttons to be XBOX buttons, PlayStation and Nintendo Switch Pro ones so the game can be enjoyed at it's most !

If You notice anything that needs to be changed, feel free to comment it down below !

To Install this mod:
---REGULAR VERSION----
1. Dowload your Pack of choice
2. Extract the XBOX/SWITCH/PS.zip in C:\Users\\AppData\Roaming\Dolphin Emulator
3. Make sure [ ] Load Custom Textures and [ ] Prefetch Custom Textures are enabled in Dolphin under "Graphics > Advanced"
--------HD VERSION--------
1. Dowload your Pack of choice
2. Dowload The NSMBWii HD Texture Pack
3. Extract the NSMBW HD.zip in C:\Users\\AppData\Roaming\Dolphin Emulator
4. After you've done this and only AFTER, Extract the XBOX/SWITCH/PS.zip in C:\Users\\AppData\Roaming\Dolphin Emulator and overwrite any files if it asks to.
4. Make sure [ ] Load Custom Textures and [ ] Prefetch Custom Textures are enabled in Dolphin under "Graphics > Advanced"

-------------------------------------------------------

profile._sText:
It's been a long time I have this project on my hands but there a long story why I didn't released it. But now here is it, as a 90% complete.

Wario & Waluigi over Toads is a mod for replacing the Blue and Yellow Toads so you can play with Mario, Luigi, Wario and Waluigi all together.

There no code or anything else, just file remplacement. Waluigi is over the Blue Toad and Wario over the Yellow Toad.

I wanted to make a custom voice for both but I wasn't able to do this cause multiples reasons.

I also included some files for the HUD and some others things (Midle Flag, etc...) and the models for the cutscenes.

This mod was supposed to be released a long time ago but the release date was moved to add more stuff and also include more quality on this. The model/texture on Wario and Waluigi is very low, that caused by the file size limit.

I also wanted to make this mod compatible with Newer Super Mario Bros., that why it wasn't released. It's compatible but I wanted to add more stuff like the power up from this mod.

I've also lost the motivation a lot of times and just after my first computer died and I've lost all files. I was able to take all files from the hard disk recently and backup them.

But now it's here, it's not perfect, it's not clean or even polished. It may need more times but I'm not the man who will be able to do that. If someone want to make a update, or use into a project go ahead but don't forget to credit.

Enjoy!

This mod isn't a simple "repaint" of Pikmin 2, it contains an entire new story with new characters, enemies, and collectibles. With over 130 new things to collect, brand new mechanics to make the game feel fresh, and 2-player story co-op this mod is a whole new Pikmin experience! 

This mod is not meant to be taken too seriously in most aspects, but its gameplay is meant to be fresh and creative for fans of the Pikmin series to enjoy even if they don't care about the memes.

profile._sText:
BIKMIN PC is a Dolphin only mod and shitpost-y repaint of Pikmin 2 with a relatively new story. Formerly known as just "Bikmin 1" or "BIKMIN", the original release of the mod has been depreciated and unobtainable for the past few years. The team behind Bikmin 269 took it upon ourselves to go back and update the original Bikmin mod to be playable in the modern age with a lot of tweaks and improvements.

Despite this being a large update to the original, it is nowhere near the standards of modern Pikmin 2 mods and we do not want to advertise it as such, outside of some quality of life additions this is essentially the same mod that was released in 2017, so don't play it expecting a mod on par with Bikmin 269.

This mod is mainly recommended for people who played Bikmin 269 and want to see what the first Bikmin mod was like, or people who want to start with the first mod before playing Bikmin 269.

Edit: Check out version 2.0 of Pikmin 1^2 where Dutch is a language in the game now! (That version includes Louie’s Quest in dutch, randomizer in dutch and a lot of fixes!) (The new download version includes all these things if you want to play in v1.1!)

I have made a faithful Dutch translation for Pikmin 1² made by Pikhacker (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aQ3U82Ulro0). (Go check it out!) 

I have already finished this: 

-Pikmin 1 game 

-menu 

-options 

-challenge mode 

-louie's quest 

-Randomizer 

What I still want to make in a future update: 

-Everything that I missed (the only thing I don't know how to create is, for example, day counter or "press start" text, so that still needs to be created) 

I put all the text in the corresponding boxes as best I could. The text file was made in version 1.1. The pikmin enemies are from the only Dutch pikmin game: pikmin 4 where I looked at the types of enemies that are not in pikmin 4 and made the best possible translation of this (e.g. Gehoornde Kanonkever = Horned cannon beetle I changed to Gepanserde Kanonkever = Armored cannon beetle etc. etc.)) If you have any questions or anything, please let me know! 

How to install:

When you have Pikmin 1² in dolphin in a path you will be good to go: (i.e. you will see it appear in your list of games)

First press the right mouse button on Pikmin 1²  -> open Properties -> in the top right press the arrow button to the right until you see "Filesystem" -> Press Filesystem -> press the right mouse button on your disk ->  extract entire disk -> (do is somewhere ez to find) Let that do its thiing for a min -> open the map in your file Explorer

Open a new tab in file explorer (downloads most likely) and extract Dutch over... text file with 7zip or winrar -> open the file and you shoud see "files" -> drag the "files" folder to your extracted pikmin 1^2 and put it on the "files" folder there.  Press replace all when that window shows up. ->  make a new path in dolphin to this (dutch) patched pikmin 1^2 . ->  (you shoud see it as main.dol in dolphin as the file name)  press the right mouse button on the new Pikmin 1² (main.dol) (0,00 B) and do convert file -> press covert and name it something like Dutch Pikmin 1^2 v1.1 and put it in your game folder (or somewhere where you put your games.  now you can delete the extracted files (NOT the iso that you just created)(everyting but that) and bingo you can play in dutch! (you shoud see a new pikmin 1^2 with the name you just created. you can check this by pressing the right mouse button on Pikmin 1²  -> open Properties. if the name of the window is the same as the one you created than that will be the dutch pikmin 1^2)

Nederlands:
installeren:

Als je Pikmin 1² in dolphin emu op een pad hebt, ben je klaar om te gaan: (oftewel je ziet het verschijnen in je lijst met games)

Druk eerst met de rechtermuisknop op Pikmin 1² -> open Eigenschappen -> druk rechtsboven op de pijlknop naar rechts totdat je "Bestandssysteem" ziet -> Druk op Bestandssysteem -> druk met de rechtermuisknop op je Schijf -> druk op "volledige schijf uitpakken..." -> (doe dit op een makkelijke te vinden plek) Laat dat een minuutje zijn werk doen -> open de map in je bestandsverkenner

Open een nieuwe tab in verkenner (downloads waarschijnlijk) en pak het Nederlands over frans tekstbestand met 7zip of winrar uit -> open het bestand en je zou "files" moeten zien -> sleep de map "files" naar je uitgepakte pikmin 1^2 en plaats het daar boven op de map "files".  Druk op alles vervangen wanneer dat venster verschijnt. -> maak een nieuw pad in dolphin emu naar deze gepatchte pikmin 1^2. -> (je zou het moeten zien als main.dol in dolphin als de bestandsnaam) druk met de rechtermuisknop op de nieuwe Pikmin 1² (main.dol) (0,00 B) en converteer het bestand -> druk op covert en noem het zoiets als Nederlandse Pikmin 1^2 v1.1 en plaats het in je gamemap (of ergens waar je je games hebt geplaatst.) Nu kun je de uitgepakte bestanden verwijderen (NIET de iso die je zojuist hebt gemaakt)(oftewel alles behave de .iso die je net heb gemaakt). Bingo! je kan  nu in het Nederlands spelen! (je zou een nieuwe pikmin 1^2 moeten zien  met de naam die je zojuist hebt gemaakt.) (dit kan je checken bij eigenschappen -> boven aan dat tabje)

profile._sText:
Galactic Date: 20XX
In the planet named PNF-404, there lies a type of species on the brink of ruin... The species' name: Pikmin.
Due to Olimar's coincidental arrival during their darkest hours, the Pikmin managed to rise up from the bottom to the very top of the food chain.
However, decades after Olimar's departure, the Pikmin are once again in danger of going extinct, in part due to a booming population, invasive species, and a basic lack of planning.
Their only hope was to pray that Olimar comes back to save them. However, within each passing seasons, they soon realized that time does not wait for his arrival, with the ever-growing danger looming closer.
Accordingly, the Pikmin elected three Pikmin to lead their species in hopes of establishing their independence from Olimar, and to prove that they can stay above the food chain and fight back against the ever growing threat of giants and beings beyond their comprehension!

This mod replaces Olimar, Louie, and that Hocotate President Le Chacho as Red, Blue, and Yellow Pikmin respectively. This only works for the GameCube version of Pikmin 2 for now. And of course this mod cannot replace the pre-rendered cutscene with Olimar, Louie, and Le Chacho.
The second video is the original mod, where this idea originated from. Please play the mod if you can.

Dolphin Emulator

2. Open Dolphin, right click on Pokemon XD on the game list, and click "Start with Riivolution Patches...".

3. Change "Dark Magician Girl over Espeon" from "Disabled" to "Enabled".

4. Click "Start" to run the game.

profile._sText:
< AI was not used in the creation of this mod >

This mod, when patched into a ROM, replaces the roster of Shadow Pokemon available into different Pokemon depending on the patch chosen. For example, the first Shadow Pokemon encountered will either be Machop, Tyrogue, or Nosepass.

Nearly every Shadow Pokemon in the game is replaced this way (the exceptions being the Starters and the Legendary Beasts in Johto version, which are kept for consistency with the other versions and have new movesets to compensate). The starting Umbreon and Espeon, the gifted Plusle, and the 100% completion Ho-Oh are unchanged.

In addition, the first Pokemon used by Rider Willie changes depending on the version as well. Use this as a way to confirm that the patch files have been applied. (Rattata for Kanto, Sentret for Johto, Wurmple for Hoenn).

In addition to a .ups patch file, each .zip contains a Readme doc with further details about what has been replaced.

I've done a lot of testing to make sure that there are no blockers or other glitches with how the replacements work. However, this is also the first mod like this that I've done so if there is any issue with getting the patch working or anything in-game tied to the mod, please let me know so I can get to work on a fix.

All three versions of this mod were tested with a vanilla version of Pokemon Colosseum. I cannot guarantee compatibility with other installed mods.

profile._sName: RO x Sonic the Hedgehog (Dolphin Ver. + HD Pack)
profile._sText:
Goodlord its has been awhile since I've modded this game..  likely because I am kinda burnout for this game modding community and its just how it is, like I've been modded this game almost 3 years ago and seeing how much goodies and mods there are nowadays .

But either way ehm..... this is the FIRST official mod for the Wii Version of Rayman Origins (but exclusive to Dolphin), and this mod only took me about 7 months to make, (which is why I believed that I haven't been making Origins mod in awhile) Which is a port of my beloved Rayman Origins x Sonic the Hedgehog Mod, Anddd its now 1 year since the mod has been release, So to communicate with the Anniversary, and for those of Dolphin users that have the game... You can now played the mod on the emulator by loading the texture up Ba-Da Boom!

This Mods includes:

Most of the Assets from the PC version of this mod are in it too (duh...) and I fixes some Tweaks for the Sprites too, this ALSO includes my Pumpkin Hill mod from the PC game into this mod .

Also hence the mod name, This also includes the Assets from the PC version of Origins into this game to be more HD and improvment, since the Vanilla version has low quality sprites to handle the Wii's hardware, same goes with Dolphin too once you put it into 1080p or 4k resolution for the game itself, the sprites looks low quality too but alittle bit more higher .

The Game Menu icons and Banner for the Wii Menu, 

and finally *Drink some more water*  this mod includes Custom Controller UIs, basically includes the PS4, Xbox, and Switch Pro controller in the game as controller UIs. they'll be more controllers for the future updates to this mod .

....and speaking of wish, this is V1 of the mod so if their any weird mistakes for the mod I'll fixed it and keep on updating this mod as soon as possible, I've been also thinking to make the cutscenes to be changed too, as its actually possible to mod the cutscenes for this version of the game using Riivolution .

Now here are the step by step of how to make the mod works....
1:  Download the Mod using the Alternate Link File at the bottom and on MEGA.nz click download

2: You must have a Rayman Origins rom for Dolphin in order to play the mod, I ain't telling ya where to get it by online (AS SOME OF THEM ARE A LITTLE RISKY) but if you have a Homebrew Wii and have the Game on the Wii, Dump the game by either using USB Loader GX or CleanRip .

3: After dumping out of the game in your SD card, Plug in your SD card into your computer.

4: Download Dolphin Emulator, SInce this mod is using the recent version of the app I highly recommand to get the 2512 version of the app,

5: After u did some of the Instrution or Extracted the app itself, Its time for the big one, Go to the Config section and click on Paths once u on there press "Add..." and select your folder roots that the ROM is in .

6: Once your game is on the screen, Go to File and select "Open User Folder" onthere you have to selected load and I believe theres the "Textures" folder too if not then create one,

7: Once you open the Textures folder, Open up this mod's folder and drag "SOJE41" (which is the Game ID for this game) and drag it into the "Textures" .

8: and then finally, click on the rom for the game in Dolphin and have fun with it also I highly recommand using this 720p or higher resolution to play this mod .

and that is it for this description for this damn mod.... since GB is being a crappy for always getting stucks at downloading mods, this mod download is exclusive to MEGA.nz .
