profile._sText:
Hardcore Challenges makes every challenge on Board Game Island tougher. Getting to the top of the island is no longer a formality!

CHANGES
- Final Challenge (gate): you now need 12 or higher (was 6+). Impossible with a single die: you'll need the bonus die you get on each new attempt at the gate.
- Dragon Wall: 5 or 6 (was 4, 5 or 6).
- Volcano or Not: 4, 5 or 6 (was 3, 4, 5 or 6).
- Spike Ball: the requirement stays at 5 or 6 for the whole game (normally it drops to 4, 3, then 2).

Everything is consistent in-game:
- The host's messages are updated in all 6 PAL languages (English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Dutch).
- The numbers shown on the board (the "6" on the gate, the challenge signs) are updated too.

REQUIREMENTS
- Wii Party, European/PAL version (SUPP01). Other regions are not supported.
- Riivolution (real Wii) or a recent Dolphin version.

INSTALLATION – WII
1. Extract the archive to the root of your SD card (the "riivolution" and "HardcoreChallenges" folders must be at the root).
2. Launch Riivolution from the Homebrew Channel and insert your Wii Party disc.
3. Set "Hardcore Challenges" to "Enabled", then press "Launch".

INSTALLATION – DOLPHIN
1. Extract the archive into Dolphin's Load/Riivolution folder:
   - Windows: Documents/Dolphin Emulator/Load/Riivolution/
   - Linux: ~/.local/share/dolphin-emu/Load/Riivolution/
   - macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Dolphin/Load/Riivolution/
2. Right-click Wii Party in the game list and choose "Start with Riivolution Patches".
3. Enable "Hardcore Challenges", then click "Start".

Your save data is not modified by the mod itself, but as always with mods, backing up your save is a good idea.

Cross-mod Compatibility

This mod is combined with many others here and can be enabled/disabled independently.

Technical Quirks

There are a few things that operate differently than you may expect but nothing that crashes the game or is considered a major bug. They could even be considered design decisions.
  1.  If you were to go backwards in the volcano, it could cause an infinite loop as the special terrain pushes you forward after you move backwards onto it. This is why the dice makes you always move forward in the volcano.
  2.  Certain checkpoints/obstacles, when triggered from behind, orient the player forwards. The most common example is the vine swing; the other cases are quite rare as they require UFO swaps. Similarly, approaching choose-a-side barrel section from behind after failing it on the previous turn causes an infinite loop until you choose incorrectly.
  3.  The volcanic dice don't add up the total visually for you nor do they make you roll a third die if you roll doubles (which does keeps things from being too brutal). They're actually leftover unused dice from the original game, and it seems this behavior wasn't implemented for them.

profile._sName: Board Game Island: "Back to Start" Space
profile._sText:
ARDescription

This mod turns the red -4 space of Board Game Island into a "back to start" space. Land on it and you are sent straight back to the starting place. The space also gets a custom texture.

Made for Poofesure Wii Party series in mind, but anyone can use it.

How it works

  • A small Gecko code changes how many spaces the -4 space moves you back (-4 becomes -80 so the beginning of the board).
  • A custom texture replaces the look of the -4 space
Supported versions

  • Wii Party PAL (game ID SUPP01): tested on Dolphin, and on a Wii U (vWii) with Gecko OS and with Riivolution.
  • Wii Party NTSC-U (game ID SUPE01): the effect is tested on Dolphin.
  • NTSC-J and NTSC-K: not supported.

HOW TO INSTALL
  • First, your Wii needs to have Riivolution installed; I won't go into the installation details here, as there are plenty of tutorials online. Assuming you already have the Riivolution channel installed (the menu button that launches Riivolution directly), simply do the following:
  • 1. Download and extract the content; you will find a README file containing instructions if you need them.
  • 2. Place all the folders inside the extracted folder if you already have a specific folder just drag the content to the folder you already have. If notdrag all to the root of your SD card—meaning directly on the card itself, not inside another folder.
  • 3. Safely eject the SD card from your computer and insert it into your Wii. You should then see the mod appear in the Riivolution channel under the name "Wii Party Back to Start." You can enable or disable it there, then launch the game using the "Launch" button. Make sure you have the *Wii Party* disc in your console's drive.
Known limitations

  • Every fixed -4 space is affected, not just one.
  • Volcano eruption spaces are not affected: they still move you back 4 (tested once)
  • Randomizer compatibility: untested.

profile._sText:
Here is a compilation of a bunch of mods I made for Wii Play, specifically the Tanks minigame. They range from gameplay changes, new level maps, and texture modifications. They are made specifically for the NTSC 1.1 version of Wii Play. Here is a complete list and description of all the mods in order:

Special Ammo Type

- You can give your own tank the same projectiles that the teal/black or green tanks shoot.

- You can also shoot normal bullets that ricochet twice (fire rate is decreased).

You're an Enemy Tank

- You can play as some of the enemy types that you encounter in this minigame (The AI tanks still attack you). You have all the attributes and appearance of the tank you choose.

- Note: If you choose to play as the green tank, you’ll have the same movement stats as the teal tank. This way it’s still difficult, but not impossible.

New Tanks

All tanks will behave differently. Each AI tank has different coloring and their behavior is changed to make fighting them different, but they all still fit the same relative roles. Maps are vanilla.

New Levels

Every single map in the game is modified to create a new experience. The enemies that appear in each respective mission are unchanged, but every map is altered to either be a variation of a vanilla map, or a completely new creation.

Wii Tanks Showdown

- The most fleshed out mod in the package, based off the swordplay showdown mode from Wii Sports Resort. It updates the enemies, has new maps, and altered textures. Every mission has been remade from 1 to 100. Every stage in swordplay corresponds across 5 missions in tanks (1-50 are normal, 51-100 are reverse). Each enemy’s behavior corresponds to the color and class they are in swordplay (plus 3 unique enemies).

- There are also alternate modes where you can play as the boss tanks or have randomized enemies.

- Overall it’s meant to be a challenge but very beatable, and encourages aggressive and fast-paced play.

- This took way too long to finish and I don’t know why I got this idea but here it is.

Randomizer

- Completely randomizes what tanks and maps appear in missions (excluding some of the special/wide open maps). There are still 540 tanks. You start with only 1 life.

- Every 10 missions you fight a map full of 1 enemy type, from brown tanks at 10 to black tanks at 90. On mission 100 you fight 1 of every enemy (except the brown tank).

Cheat Mode

- There are two options for this mode, both are extremely ridiculous. It’s kind of meant to replicate the feel of gecko code cheats. Players only makes the player tanks have super speed, greatly increased mines, and greatly increased ammo. Complete chaos affects all tanks and gives them a bunch of effects similar to the players only mode.

Hard Mode

- Each enemy is made to be more difficult in this mode. Changes include better dodging ability, faster fire rate, faster movement speed, etc.

- Meant to be a simple mode for people who want a more challenging tanks experience.

Important Points

- Co-op: All these mods should work with co-op, but not all of them have custom missions. The following mods have randomized missions: special ammo type, new tanks, new levels, and randomizer.

- Emulator: Every mod has been fully tested on emulator and they should all work.

- Actual hardware: All of them should work on a real Wii with Riivolution, but they’re not 100% tested. Also unlike on emulator, some mods/levels might lag the game if there’s too many objects on screen at once.

- Riivolution: Enable only one mod at a time. Trying to enable multiple won’t work. I would love to have combined mods, but I don’t want to take more time out of my life to figure that out.

- Custom music/sound effects: I would love to, but the Tanks sound file is impossible to edit with the tools I used to create these mods.

- Aspect Ratio: This entire modpack is intended to be played in 16:9 aspect ratio. Don't play them in 4:3. Just don't. For example: New levels and Showdown will not load the correct maps and/or softlock you if you play in 4:3.

- Please report any issues that come up so I can fix them.

Enjoy!

---Updates---

11/27/23
- Adjusted a few maps in Showdown to play better
- Added a simple mode that increases the difficulty of each enemy for a more challenging experience

1/16/24
- Added another ammo type and made small adjustments to the other two
- Made some small nerfs to a couple enemies in hard mode
- Added a "proper" co-op campaign for Showdown and some map adjustments

OFFICAL SITE: http://www.jimmysstuff.tk/index/rii_play/0-29

(Formerly known as the "RiiPlay Expansion Pack") is a modpack for Wii Play created by JimmyKaz and cyndifusic.

It was originally just going to be Kaizo Tanks! but JimmyKaz discovered how to use custom sound effects in minigames that store their sound effects in uneditable BRSAR files (BrawlCrate doesn't support older versions of BRSAR). So cyndifusic and JimmyKaz decided to make edits to every game adding new stuff and features.

Key Features

Find Mii Randomizer: This feature loads Custom Find Mii levels in the game. Seems normal right? Well... The levels have had their Objectives randomized. And some levels even implement the unused Zooming Feature in them. And some levels have the unused "Find the Insomniac" Objective. 

All Terrian Tanks!: This feature loads custom levels for the Tanks! Minigame. To make things more interesting we have also edited the tank parameters and textures to make it snow themed.

Ultimate Kaizo Challenge: This feature makes every game Kaizo. It works the best on Tanks! Every time you want to update the scene press the plus button on the Wii Remote.

 

Credits:

  • The Goldfish King, for creating extensive documentation on the formatting of Tanks game files, helping troubleshoot a large texture issue, and beta testing the pack
  • GibHaltmannKill, for creating Blitzkrieg Tools, a pack of Windows programs that help edit Tanks levels and level titles, and also for helping us troubleshoot issues with custom titles through his impressive Assembly knowledge
 

  • cyndifusic, Creating Kaizo Tanks and helping fix the Force v1.01 Patch
 

  • Kitlith, for creating the Find Mii Level Editor & Randomizer
  • JimmyKaz, for creating textures, A few of the songs, and for updating the code in the Randomizer Portion of the Find Mii Level Editor to fix any incompatibilities in-game
  • Neutrii101, Creating Missions 13-30 in All Terrain Tanks!


This pack couldn't have been possible without these people, so a big thank you goes out to every one of them.

Anything in green bolded text means that feature has been implemented into the training games.

Golf Features:

Golf Holes/Rounds: Lets you select any golf course in the game including two unused courses!

Repeat Hole/Round: Repeats any golf course or golf training round you selected (This will finish the game on Target Practice and sometimes Putting)

Wind: Locks the wind which ranges from 0-30 mph (or 0-15 m/s). Has 2 more intense winds if you want to have fun with it.

Direction: Locks the direction of the wind to anything you set it to.

Pins: Sets the hole location. (PINS 4-6 ONLY WORK ON CLASSIC HOLE 2 AND RESORT 2-9)

Retry Shots: Click (-) once, and you will be able to retry any shot if you feel like it. Make sure to click (-) again if you want it to go back to normal. (THIS WILL NOT WORK WITH FORCE DISCONNECT)

Force Disconnect: Click and Hold (-) to force the disconnect glitch instead of taking out the battery. Release (-) to go back to normal (Thank you Kiwi for letting me use this!) (THIS ONLY WORKS ON NTSC_U V1.01)

Pause Anywhere: Exactly what it sounds like

Hole in One Practice Mode: Lets you practice getting a Hole in One on every hole that's possible to get one.

Force 4:3 on Wii U: Changes the aspect ratio to 4:3 temporarily.

Always Fairway: Makes it so almost every surface is a Fairway. This includes the green. (THIS DOESN'T WORK ON WATER OR OUT OF BOUNDS)

Disable +2 Stroke: This makes it so when you get into a Hazard, it won't add 2 to the Stroke Counter.

Low Gravity: Lowers the Gravity in Golf (Try to get a Hole in One with this)

Instant Shot: Exactly what it sounds like (You will have to memorize the Shot Count)

Golf Background Music: Adds background music to regular golf (You can change the music if you know how to work with BRSTM files)

Wii Sports Resort: This lets you play ALL 9 courses from Wii Sports Resort in OG Wii Sports! The courses are almost EXACTLY like the original. The Special Courses are included as well. You can even use the practice mode on this as well! (DO NOT LOAD HITTING THE GREEN WITH THIS ENABLED)

Custom Golf Courses: While porting the Resort courses to Wii Sports, I discovered how to make fully working custom golf courses! There are 9 courses for you to play! I don't want to spoil too much, so have fun! (There's a secret 10th Course, try to find it!)

Mini Golf: Complete 9 Custom Mini Golf Courses as fast as you can! Inspired by a different mod by Kiwi and ZPL made for Chizplays. (Try to get a Hole in One on all of them!)

Driving Range: Based on the Driving Range game from Wii Fit Plus, hit the golf ball as hard as you can and see how close you can get the the hole.

Harder Golf: Replaces most of the collision with Out of Bounds except for the Fairway and Green. Originally was going to be called "Kaizo Golf", but it's kind of easy compared to what most people would imagine a Kaizo Golf course to be like.

Custom Clubs: Are you tired of the boring 4 clubs, well now you can customize the clubs you have. The only option we have so far are the secret Umbrella Golf Clubs from Wii Sports Club.

Putting Tries: Selects how many chances you are allowed to get in putting (If you choose infinite, make sure to miss on the first try or else the game finishes. It's also 255, not infinite)

ISSUES:

Holes: When loading the E3 Hole, do NOT load into the game with 4 Players. The reason is similar to what happens when you load it with 3 Players, it will load a player 4 when their shouldn't be one, so I'm assuming that the game will try to load a player 5, but that doesn't exist so it crashes the game. 

With 3 players mentioned, in the E3 Hole if you encounter this player 4, restart the game once player 1 and 2 are done. You might be asking about player 3, well it doesn't show up anywhere in the game, and player 4 can't finish the game even after a chip in, or a give up.

When loading up the E3 course (notice a pattern?), use a wind mod or else the wind will be over 9 MILLION MPH, making the course unplayable. The E3 course is very weird

Directions: This mode will affect every hole EXCEPT the Training and E3 Holes.

Wii Sports Resort: Hole 8 has visual issues but it shouldn't affect any gameplay.

Custom Courses: Some of the courses green textures glitch and we couldn't find a way to fix it. This does go away on Dolphin Emulator. Hole 2 doesn't have a visible hole. You can soft lock yourself on Hole 1. Hole 9 can glitch and it takes 30 seconds to go back to normal. It's also VERY buggy.

Mini Golf: No visible golf hole. I don't think Hole 7 is possible to get a Hole In One, if it is possible then that's great.

Harder Golf: Lags VERY badly. I don't know the cause of this issue sadly, could be the WSC Umbrellas mod.

Compatibility:

This mod will work with NTSC, PAL, and JPN consoles, however this won't work with PAL Wii U consoles.

(NTSC_U = America | PAL = Europe | NTSC_J/JPN = Japan)

This mod works on both the 1.01 and 1.00 Versions of Wii Sports!

If you have experience with gecko code editing, you can make your own version for the Combo Disc version. There will be no "official" release for the combo disc version of Wii Sports and Wii Sports Resort. If you decide to make it and everything works, DM me so I can release it myself.

DM "ballpark00.carc" on Discord if you have any bugs. Enjoy the Golf Practice and Service Pack!

profile._sText:
Think 70 Miis is not enough for Swordplay Showdown? Also think 80 is not enough? Well, this mod increase the enemy count to 100 for every stage in Swordplay Showdown! Additionally, a difficulty scale was added for more variety, so you can have either an easier time fighting or a harder time fighting.

This mod currently has seven available intensity levels, which are:
Intensity 1: Very Easy - Great for beginners or players who are new to the game. Green armors are the most common armor. Enemies do not use different attacking techniques.
Intensity 2: Easy - A difficulty that adds more defensive enemies. More two heart enemies show up. Enemies do not use different attacking techniques.
Intensity 3: Casual - A difficulty that is slightly easier than the original Swordplay Showdown. Introduces different attacking techniques from Gold Armors in the Reverse stages.
Intensity 4: Normal - A balanced difficulty that closely matches the difficulty of the original Swordplay Showdown.
Intensity 5: Tough - A difficulty that makes the mode slightly harder than usual. Green armors start to use different attacking techniques in Reverse stages. Purple armors twirl their swords more often or become aggressive.
Intensity 6: Hard - A difficulty that starts spicing things up more than usual. Even normal stages will start to feel like Reverse stages from the original game! Red armors will start using different attacking techniques here!
Intensity 7: Very Hard - A difficulty that takes things to a whole new level! Aggressive enemies become much more common, and even Green Armors can put up a serious fight! Expect tougher enemy combinations, more dangerous Black Armors, and relentless final waves that will put your blocking skills to the test!

Later updates will add more difficulties to this mod, and the final version of the mod will have 10 difficulties available, so stay tuned!

PLEASE NOTE: This is my first ever mod for Wii Sports Resort, so please be aware that mistakes may have occurred while making this mod. Thank you for understanding.

profile._sName: WSR Custom Bowling Balls, Effects, and Alleys
profile._sText:
i may have gone too far...

16 New bowling balls, 5 animated alley themes and unique ball trails for Wii Sports Resort: Pro orbs, Gold & Diamond tiers, random alleys every game.

    RECOMMENDED SETUP (the creator's pick - random everything, effects on)

    - Ball mod: Pro: random orb each game

    - Alley: Random

    - Ball trail: Match ball (Auto)

    - P1-P4 Pro ball tier: set Gold once you reach 1500 skill, Prismatic Diamond at 2000

    Every game then brings a new alley and a new orb, each with its own matching trail.

    ALL OPTIONS (under "WSR Custom Bowling Balls" in the Riivolution menu)

    - Ball mod

        Pro: random orb each game - Pro players get a random animated orb every game (recommended)

        Pro: - always that orb (Holographic, Venom Swirl, Inferno, Black Hole, Arcane Void, Dragon's Eye)

        TEST: non-Pro balls get the random orbs - see the orbs without being Pro

    - Alley

        Random - a new alley every game, never the same twice in a row (recommended)

        Cosmic Glow / Synthwave Sunset / Aurora Ice / Lava Forge / Whiteout - always that alley

    - Ball trail

        Match ball (Auto) - every ball gets its own trail and colours (recommended)

        Aura / Sparks - one effect for everyone, in your ball's colour

    - P1 / P2 / P3 / P4 Pro ball tier

        Gold / Prismatic Diamond - upgrades that player number's Pro ball (honour system: 1500 / 2000 skill)

    Every option works on its own, in any combination. Turn them all off and the game is stock.

    INSTALL

    1. Copy the "riivolution" and "WSR_ball_mod" folders from the zip to the root of your SD card

       (updating: replace both folders; your settings carry over).

    2. Start Riivolution / Friivolution and choose Wii Sports Resort.

    3. Set the options under "WSR Custom Bowling Balls" (see Recommended setup above) and launch.

    ALLEY THEMES (5, new in v2.0)

    Every alley has animated screens above the pins, its own room lighting, and themed lanes, arrows, gutters and pins:

    - Cosmic Glow: blacklight space alley, glitter lanes, a ringed bowling-ball planet, chase-light gutters

    - Synthwave Sunset: 80s neon grid, chrome gutters, a retro sun setting behind palm trees

    - Aurora Ice: frozen lanes under rippling northern lights

    - Lava Forge: obsidian lanes split by flowing lava seams, an erupting volcano

    - Whiteout: a bright gallery alley with dark pins in a random colourway (onyx, navy, garnet or forest)

    BALL TRAIL (new in v2.0)

    The rolling ball leaves a trail of particles on its way to the pins. With "Match ball (Auto)" every ball gets its own:

    a violet aura with white stars for Galaxy, fire and embers for Inferno, gold glitter for Gold, rainbow and sparkle for

    the Prismatic Diamond, and so on.

    ANIMATED PRO ORBS (6)

    Players at Pro rank (1000+ skill) get an animated orb - a random one each game (each Pro player rolls their own),

    or pick your favourite: Holographic, Venom Swirl, Inferno, Black Hole, Arcane Void, Dragon's Eye.

    GOLD & PRISMATIC DIAMOND (2)

    Prestige balls for the grinders: unlock Gold at 1500 skill and the Prismatic Diamond at 2000

    (set per player number in the Riivolution menu).

    RANDOM BALLS FOR EVERYONE ELSE (8)

    Every non-Pro player gets a random design each time Bowling loads:

    Riptide, Galaxy, Tie-Dye, Hyperspin, Smiley, Emerald 420, Stained Glass, Synthwave.

    NOTES

    - Player number = the order Miis are picked (P1 = first Mii).

    - The 100-Pin alley stays stock.

    - If Bowling crashes or stays black while loading, try a single-orb ball choice or a single alley.

    - Source code, previews and build guide: https://github.com/mrqwex10/wsr-custom-bowling-balls

    CREDITS

    - qwex10 - creator

    - Claude (Anthropic) - development help

    - Wiimm - Wiimms ISO/SZS Tools (used to build)

    - Riivolution team - mod loader

profile._sName: Wii Sports Resort x Mario Kart DS
profile._sText:
This is the Wii Sports Resort x Mario Kart DS Pack!

This replaces Wuhu Island with 3 courses from Mario Kart DS. This is more of an experimental mod to test custom Cycling paths, but it worked good so I decided to release it. Here is what each course does.

Yoshi Falls: Has a custom showdown stage on stage 1 (Bridge)

Figure-8 Circuit: Has a custom cycling course that replaces "Around the Island"

Desert Hills: Has a custom cycling course that replaces "Around the Island"

FAQ:
How do I install this? Open the README.txt in the zip file.

Why Mario Kart DS? It was the easiest to port over without any bugs for the collision or textures. I also just like the courses from that game.

Could it be possible to do other courses from other games? Yes, but this pack was mainly made for Mario Kart DS courses in mind.

Why only 3 courses: I could do more, however, it is VERY time-consuming. Desert Hills took 4 hours just for that one course.

Why did you release this? It's fun and I think you should always release fun mods!

ISSUES:

Some of the CPU Mii's get stuck on the fence on Yoshi Falls. The yellow preview path is broken on Figure 8 Circuit. There are no visible shadows on any of the courses, however, the shadows on Desert Hills are broken. The goal is really weird to get around in Desert Hills.

I haven't tested the mod on PAL consoles, but it should work considering that it's just stage file replacements.

profile._sText:
VERSION 11 IS CURRENTLY IN DEVELOPMENT. IT WILL BE THE LAST VERSION OF THIS MOD!

 

THIS WILL NOT WORK ON PAL WII U CONSOLES!

Wii Sports Resort: Storm Island is a full in-depth modpack created by The Storm Island Team! This is a modpack that modifies and adds new features to Wii Sports Resort!

There are many.... many.... many... features in this modpack, but the highlight features of this modpack are listed below!

 

 

 

First things first....

 

 

ALWAYS ENABLE THE STORM ISLAND OPTION AND HOME BUTTON SONG, THEY ARE REQUIRED FOR THIS MODPACK TO WORK PROPERLY

ALWAYS LEAVE DUNK CONTEST AND ENDLESS SHOWDOWN DISABLED WHEN YOU'RE NOT USING EITHER OF THEM. IF YOU WANT TO USE EITHER OF THEM, EVERY SINGLE FEATURE MUST BE TURNED OFF INCLUDING THE MAIN PATCH AND THE HOME BUTTON SONG.

 

(NTSC = America |  PAL = Europe)

 

ENHANCEMENTS:

IF YOU USE ANY OF THE ENHANCEMENTS HIGHLIGHTED IN RED, YOU MUST DISABLE: GOLF SETTINGS, GOLF PRACTICE MODE, SHOWDOWN RANDOMIZER, AND DUNK CONTEST / ENDLESS SHOWDOWN for it to work.

 

  • Cycling No Heart Loss : This mode allows you to pedal through courses without losing any hearts!
  • ShowdownGodMode : Makes you invincible in Swordplay Showdown.
  • Flyover Teleporter : Teleports you to a saved location.
  • Colored Text : Colored Text. Truly Revolutionary.
  • Bowling Speed Hack : When you throw the ball, it will move across the lane at high speeds! (If you throw the ball backwards, it will give you a practice shot!)
  • Sentient Golf Ball : Whenever you hit the ball, it will have a random path! It makes for quite an amusing playthrough.
  • Crazy Text : Corrupted text.
  • Orchidland Golf : Makes everything more lively in Golf.
  • Texture Randomizer : Every time you move around the map, the textures around you will change!
  • Masters Ping Pong : A new challenge for Table Tennis! Every time that you hit the ball, it bounces higher and higher! (You will have to hit the ball softly while serving). This also has amusing affects if you use it in Swordplay.
  • No Flyover Timer : This disables the timer in Island Flyover!
  • Idle Defense : This keeps the defense from moving in Basketball (affects both teams).
  • Wii Play Ping Pong : Every time you hit the ball in Table Tennis, it gets faster and faster!
  • Dunk Only Basketball : Exactly what it sounds like! (A 3 point dunk is possible, you just have to time it correctly. However, the game is programmed to only give 2 points for a dunk)
  • 510 MPH Winds : A new challenge for Golf! This makes the wind speed 510 mph.
  • CompleteCorruptedChaos : Exactly what it sounds like.
  • BouncyBowling : In bowling, the ball will bounce different amounts based on your throws.
  • FirstPersonShowdown : First person Swordplay Showdown.
  • TENET : Everything is backwards and upside down.
  • RTX OFF : Very low quality textures.
  • PingPongCrisis : Funny effects in Table Tennis.
  • Semi Wireframe (FLASHING LIGHTS WARNING) : Texture effect.
  • Kids Basketball : Short Miis playing basketball.
  • True Texture Randomizer : The textures in the game will be randomized whenever you press the B button!
  • Masters Showdown : Bored of regular showdown? This feature will add an amusing result to the defeat of an enemy!
  • ImpossiBowl : In bowling, the pins won't fall over. This makes it nearly impossible, but not fully impossible.
  • Masters Bowling : In bowling, once the ball touches a pin, complete chaos ensues.
  • Cycling Tornado : When cycling, pressing the B button with this feature will send you flying into the air! If done right, you can skip over half the course!
  • Tsunami on Command : In Power Cruising and Canoeing, pressing the B button will trigger a massive wave! (You have 14 seconds to press B again after activating the Tsunami before the game crashes)
  • CyclingRandomness : Cycling Randomness.
  • Debug Menu : This feature enables the hidden Debug Menu within the game (shown in the last image). It works for Power Cruising, Island Flyover, and Wakeboarding.
  • CyclingReach27th : Try to reach 27th place in Cycling with this enabled. It's not as easy as you think!
  • ZeroGravityBasketball : Miis will climb higher and higher with each shot.
  • Hurricane Bowling : A mod by Boshi for Spin Control. This makes it look like you're bowling in a bowling alley that was hit by a Hurricane
  • ImprobaBowl : A mod by Boshi. This is an easier version of ImpossiBowl.
 

 

Golf Settings:

The features that are highlighted in red will not work unless Golf Practice Mode, Showdown Randomizer, Enhancements, Dunk Contest, and Endless Showdown are disabled.

 

  • Jesus Mode : This allows you to go into areas that are normally out of bounds! (ie: The river of Classic Hole 6)
  • Reverse OOB : With this mode, you will only be able to golf in the out of bounds areas. You will have to try the best you can to make it to the green!
  • CompleteChaos : Exactly what it sounds like.
  • Out of this World : A new set of background elements for every course!
  • Custom Courses (WIP) : 2 custom courses. Unfinished.
  • Give Up Faster : This can be used to quickly speed through a game.
  • Expert Only Golf : Good luck putting with this enabled.
  • Blind Golf : The closer you get to Hole 18, the harder the courses are to complete...
  • Golf Telekinesis : This allows you to control the ball with the Wiimote. You need to hold the minus button and use the d-pad, to control the ball AFTER you swing.
  • One Shot Golf : This makes golf a lot more challenging, you will have to swing as hard as you can, because the ball will not bounce once it touches the ground.
  • Cameraman Crisis : Funny camera effects in golf.
  • Sentient Flag : The flag will move to a random location after each swing. Good Luck!
  • Gliderball : After hitting the ball, pressing minus allows the ball to move forward without losing it's initial momentum. If done correctly, you can get a hole in one on hole 18!
  • Tannenbaum's Quest : Pressing minus after hitting the ball and deactivating it a second later will cause it to move to a random location, depending on how quickly you use it, it can help you progress further across the course!
  • Negative Wind : You can alternate between regular wind and negative wind in golf by pressing the minus button!
  • N64 : Somehow, the tree animation in this mode looks a bit more realistic than the actual one used in the game.
  • Quest Of Clubs : The more you hit the ball, the less clubs you are able to use.
  • Memory Game : This is a test to see how well you really know this game.

  • Driving Range : This lets you play on the driving range from Wii Fit Plus. It can be completed, but it's only a proof of concept until the proper code edits can be made. Load this through Classic A Hole 1. IF THE GROUND STARTS MOVING, RESTART IMMEDIATELY

  • Target Practice: The target practice minigame from Wii Sports. Load this through classic hole 10. TURN OFF ENHANCEMENTS, SHOWDOWN RANDOMIZER, AND ENDLESS SHOWDOWN/DUNK CONTEST TO USE THIS. THIS WILL NOT WORK ON PAL.

  • Seasons Change: A mod by Fxreboys that changes the courses to take place in Winter.

  • Treeless : No trees.
  • Wii Sports Club : This is probably the most anticipated feature of this entire modpack! I worked on this with fellow modder, boz.

    This feature allows you to play on the golf courses from Wii Sports Club! It took an entire summer to port every course and get them working in game!

    ISSUES:

    -     To put it simply, the game only allocates a certain amount of memory for golf, a few of the courses come extremely close to exceeding that amount. So we were not able to port over every single tree that exists in the WSC version of the courses

    -     "Heavy Rough" or any collision type similar to it does not exist in Wii Sports Resort, so it was changed to a regular rough.

    -      Due to how the intro cameras work, we were not able to recreate the original course intros from Wii Sports Club.

    -      We tried literally everything to fix the lag on Hole 7, sadly nothing can be done without breaking the collision

    - The map display dimensions are hardcoded, so the position of hole 8's map couldn't be changed. 
 

Bonus Content:

  • ImpossiPong : In this mode, Cole becomes a very skilled player, even better than Lucia! You have to play it yourself to get the full experience.
  • ImpossiBALL : When using this in Basketball Pickup Game, you will have to try extremely hard to score.
  • Enhanced Basketball : This extends the maximum shooting range all the way up to the half court line (Try this with Dunk Only Mode :) )
  • NoVideos : Allows you to skip the Wii Motion Plus videos if you haven't already watched them.
  • Casual Showdown : Nobody wears armor in Showdown.
 

 

 

Endless Golf:

All 21 courses will repeat forever. You can complete a course, but you can't complete a run.
Restarting won't work either. You get locked at Stroke 1 forever.

THIS WILL NOT WORK ON PAL


 

 

SAVESTATES: 

This allows you to create a new savegame on your SD Card if you're worried about messing with your console savegame.
If you use the "EmulateCurrentSave" option, it clones your console savegame to your SD Card and loads it from there, allowing you to play this mod without affecting your console's savegame at all.

 

HOME BUTTON SONG:


This is powers a large majority of this modpack, always enable it. 



Basketball + PNG Theme:

This feature adds a background theme to Basketball and Table Tennis!

ARCHERY AND CYCLING MODS:

UnusedCyclingAndArchery :
This feature allows you to play on the unused archery stages left in the game (Not all of them work due to their impossible locations placed back when the beta island was being used for the game.) 

This feature also loads the 2 unused cycling stages left in the game. (Stage 1 can't be completed unless you use Cycling Tornado Mode). 

 
Archery Extravaganza 1 and 2:
24 Custom stages from the Archery Extravaganza mod by Fxreboys.

Going The Distance:
 A mod by Fxreboys. The target will be further back every stage. Good Luck.
 
 

 

Custom Showdown Stages:

This has 8 custom showdown level packs. 3 of them take place on different maps.

 The 5th level pack (Swordplay Showdown Ultimate) has every single CPU set to the highest possible difficulty, even harder than Matt.

Custom Maps:

  • (WiiPlayPyramid) The Mysterious Upside Down Pyramid : It's the full location and an expansion of the environment from the Fishing Game from Wii Play.
  • Lake Moderato : A valley with a golden lake in the center.
  • Paper Platform : This pack is actually slightly more difficult than "Swordplay Showdown Ultimate" because of a quicker attack time for certain CPUs.
 

Golf Practice Mode:

This lets you play on any course you want in Golf. Although, if you want a better version of this, check out Caddie

THIS WILL NOT WORK ON PAL

If you want to use this mode, you will need to disable: Golf Settings, Showdown Randomizer, Enhancements (Only the highlighted ones), Dunk Contest, and Endless Showdown
 

Swordplay Showdown Randomizer:

Tired of the same exact sequence of enemies and difficulty in Swordplay Showdown? Then this is a perfect feature to use!

Every time you restart the game, the enemy armor type, heart amount, and difficulty gets randomized! Making every level different!

I won't spoil the settings for you. It's a lot more fun if you try it out yourself!

THIS WILL NOT WORK ON PAL


 

If you want to use the Showdown Randomizer, you will need to disable: Golf Settings, Golf Practice Mode, Enhancements (Only the highlighted ones) Dunk Contest, and Endless Showdown Mode

 

Dunk Contest and Endless Showdown:

Both of these were previously released. However, I managed to partially integrate them into this mod.

DUNK CONTEST WILL NOT WORK ON PAL DUE TO THE COMPLEXITY AND REGION SPECIFIC PATCHES USED.

THIS FEATURE WILL NOT WORK UNLESS YOU DISABLE EVERY SINGLE FEATURE. INCLUDING THE MAIN PATCH AND THE HOME BUTTON SONG.

STRATEGIES/TIPS/WARNINGS:

  • For the Bowling Speed Hack, if you're doing 100 Pin Bowling and you want to cheese the perfect game, slightly tap either left or right two times, and use the railing to hit the red button.
  • For Wii Play Ping Pong, always watch the ball carefully because if your opponent hits the ball but doesn't land it on the table, don't hit it back.
  • When using Golf Telekinesis, activate it AFTER you hit the ball, otherwise you will get softlocked and have to restart.
  • When playing on the Driving Range on PAL, restart/quit immediately after the score pops up or else the game may crash.

profile._sName: Swordplay Showdown Service Pack + Endless Showdown
profile._sText:
The "Service and Shenanigans" pack is a mod that provides an entirely new set of features and stages to Swordplay Showdown.

The most notable feature in this mod is "Endless Showdown", a mod that extends the number of Miis in a stage way beyond its normal limit of 100.

Originally, I wanted to include this feature in the upcoming Version 11 update of Wii Sports Resort: Storm Island, but Riivolution doesn't work in a way that would have allowed me to integrate it into the mod as I would have liked. So, I decided to give it a standalone release and add some accompanying features.

A big complaint that I saw about Storm Island was the lack of PAL support. The truth behind that is that NTSC and PAL memory addresses differ by 0x320 bytes, and trying to make PAL versions of all the memory patches is a very time-consuming task and sometimes even causes crashes. However, while testing this mod, I came across a small solution to this issue that I'm planning to hopefully integrate into the next Storm Island update.

Riivolution XML files support the use of "Search Patches." Unlike regular memory patches, they don't need an exact memory address.

I realized that the actual code for the game is basically the same in the NTSC and PAL versions. The only major differences are in parts that write to specific memory addresses and various other things. So, I took advantage of that with a search patch.

A "search patch" looks through the game's memory for an exact set of bytes. Then, it replaces those bytes with a value that you specify. However, it can also search for the hex values of instructions within the game's code. Since the game's code is basically the same between regions, the byte sequences are too. This means that a singular search patch will work for both NTSC and PAL games without needing separate patches for each region.

I documented some of this more in depth with a "developer's commentary" that I included with this mod. It also explains my development process behind some of the code in the mod. 

Apart from "Endless Showdown," this mod also features custom stage packs and "shenanigans," which let you change a few gameplay settings, as well as a feature to make each stage take place during a specific time of day. I don't want to spoil too much for you.

Compatibility:
 This mod will work on both NTSC and PAL consoles, but there's still some issues.

Compatibility Issues:
- Loading Wii Sports Resort on Riivolution on a PAL Wii U doesn't work at all, even with no mods enabled, so this will only work for PAL users if you use a PAL Wii.

- I don't have a way of testing mods on an NTSC-J console, but given that this works on both NTSC and PAL, I'd assume it'd also work for NTSC-J consoles.
